'byin to/ /'jig rten rnams snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur to/ /lha'i bu brgya stong a la la zhes sgra 'byin cing tshig 'di skad ces smras so/ /e ma'o deng 'dir lha'i bus seng ge'i sgra 'di bsgrags pas 'dzam bu 1 gling du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba lan gnyis byung ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa dang / chos nyid kyis 2'di ltar 'gyur te/ nam sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'dzum pa mdzad pa de'i tshe 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'di lta ste/mthing ga dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / le brgan dang / shel dang / dngul gyi kha dog lta bu zhal nas byung ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams ma/tha' yas pa khyab par byas nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du mngon par 'phags te phyir log nas/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyi bor 5mi snang bar gyur to// //bam po drug pa ste tha ma/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshangs pa khyad par sems kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /ye shes kun mchog pha rol phyin cing thub pa kun mkhyen kun zil gnon tsho/ /'di la dus gsum sems can spyod pa sna tshogs ci mchis khyod kyis mkhyen/ /gang de shin tu grol ba'i blo yul gang yang de dag bsam pa rnams/ / lha yi 7gtso bo kun mkhyen 'dzum mdzad 'di yi rgyu ni lung bstan gsol/ /nyan thos rang rgyal dgra bcom dri med de dag gis yang /spyod yul min/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bsam mi khyab cing mtha' bral khyod la chags pa med/ /khyod kyis sems can spyod pa sems can gang la ci 'dra'i gtam brjod mkhyen/ /smra mchog thub dka' tshig dbang 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu ni bstan par gsol/ /'od 'di shin tu yid 59—214

'ong sdug pa dri med rab tu rnam par mdzes/ /nyi zla'i 'od dang de bzhin tshangs pa dbang po'i gzi yang zil gyis gnon/ /de bzhin khor 1yug khrag khrig ri rab dag kyang shin tu snang bgyis na/ /ci slad khyod kyis 'dzum mdzad de yi 2rgyu ni rab tu bstan par gsol/ /'dod chags zhe sdang dregs la sogs pa zug rngu bral zhing rab tu zhi/ /'jig rten lha mi lto 'phye'i tshogs rnams byams pas bdag po khyod zhal lta/ /bde gshegs bltas kyang mi ngoms lus ni rab tu sim zhing bde bar 'gyur/ /gang gi slad du 'dzum pa 'di bstan thub pa bdag cag rnams la gsungs/ /khyod kyis chos rnams nam mkha' lta bur rtag tu byed med gsog nyid dang / /glog dang sprin 'dra sgyu ma lta bur gsob nyid dbu ba lta bu dang ske/ /rmi lam mthong dang chad pa stong 'dra nam mkha' chu zla lta bur mkhyen/ /dge ba 'dzum mdzad 'di rgyu rnar snyan gsung ni rab tu brjod par mdzod/ /'dzin dang rtog dang rnam rtog kun dang bral bas stong pa nyid la mos/ /bdag po shes bya kun la rtog bral rtag tu mtshan ma med la dgyes/ /khyod ni srid pa gsum 'dir gang la'ang mi smon bsam gtan ting 'dzin dgyes/ /gang gi slad du 'dzum pa bstan mdzad 'dren pa 'di ni lung bstan gsol/ /skad la mi chags sgra dang dbyangs dang yi ge dag la'ang de bzhin te/ /'jig rten du yang chos ston blo gtsang bdag dang chos la'ang gnas mi mdzad/ /'dus pa so sor bde gshegs bdag la tha dad chos ston snyam du 'dzin/ /ye shes rdzu 'phrul dbang po stobs mchog rgyas pa shes rab mtshungs med gsungs/ /khyod ni sdug bsngal kun sel na rga 'chi 'joms musman pa'i mchog lags te/ /khyod ni dpa' bo bdud kyi stobs 'joms 6mthu bo che yi snye mthu dang ldan/ /khyod ni skyob pa 59—215

dpung gnyen 'jig rten mgon skyabs 1sgron ma snang mdzad pa/ /lha min lha dang klus mchod 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu gang 'dir bstan gsol/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshangs pa khyad par sems la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /tshangs pa khyod kyis phyir mi ldog pa'i lha'i bu 'di mthong ngam / gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshangs pa phyir mi ldog pa nalha'i bu 'di /bskal pa brgya ca/stong phrag sum cu rtsa gnyis na 'jig rten gyi khams legs par sprul pa zhes bya bar bskal pa tshangs pas bstod pa la bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu rimangon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang / zhabs su ldan pa la/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ bla na med pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur 7ba/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ri rab sgron ma'i rgyal po zhes bya bar na'ajig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur te/de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de yang bee drurya 9dang / 'dzam bu 7chu bo'i gser dang /rin po che gnyis kyi gzhir 'gyur ro/ /de'i byang chub sems dpa' 11dge 'dun 'ba' zhig 'byung ste bdud dang phyir rgol ba bcom zhing dpa' bo sha stag go/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na bza' ba dang / btung ba yang bsam 1 pa tsam gyis 'byor cing dga' ldan gyi longs spyod dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de tshe dpag tu med cing ltung ba med pa'i chos ston par 'gyur ri/khyad par sems kyis smras pa/ lha'i bu khyod de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan to / /smras pa/ tshangs pa bdag ni 5de bzhin nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings ji 59—216

lta ba bzhin du lung bstan to/ /smras pa/ lha'i bu de bzhin nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings ni lung mi 1bstan to/ /smras pa/ ji ltar de bzhin nyid dang /chos kyi dbyings lung mi bstan 5pa bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la lung bstan pa yang de ltar blta'o/ /smras pa/ lha'i bu de 'ang das khyod de ltar de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan pas na khyod sngon gyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rkyal rnams kyi drung du tshangs par spyad capa la gnas pa ni don med pa ma yin no/ /smras pa/ tshangs pa gang gnas med pa de ni tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa'o/ /smras pa/ lha'i bu de 5ltar gang la gnas pa med pa de ni 6tshangs par spyad 7pa la gnas pa yin/ smras pa/ tshangs pa gang khams gsum la mi gnas pa de ni tshangs par spyad 8pa la gnas pa'o9/ /tshangs pa gang yang khams gsum la gnas pa de ni tshangs par spyad 1 pa la gnas pa 11ma/ yin no/ /gzhan yang tshangs pa gang bdag la mi 12gnas/ sems can dang / srog dang /gang zag la mi gnas pa de ni tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa yin te/ tshangs pa mdor na gang chos thams cad la 1 mi gnas pa de ni tshangs par 1 spyod pa la gnas pa'o15/ /smras pa/ lha'i 17bu tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa zhes bya ba de gang gi tshig bla dgas yin/ smras 1 pa/ tshangs par spyod pa la gnas zhes bya ba ni tshangs pa gnyis su med pa'i lam la rab tu gnas pa'i tshig bla dgas sol/ /smras pa/ lha'i bu lam la rab tu gnas pa yang ci la rab tu gnas pa yin / smras pa/ tshangs pa lam la rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba ni 1 chos thams cad la rab tu gnas pa med pa'i tshig bla dgas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab tu gnas 19pa med pa dang / len pa med pa de 20ni lam la rab tu gnas 53—217

pa'o / /smras pa/ lha'i bu ji ltar bsgom pa 1na lam sgom napa yin/ smras pa/tshangs pa ji nas kyang dngos po dang dngos po med par mi ltung ba dang / chos gang yang dngos por yang mi byed/ dngos po med par yang 4mi byed par sgom pa ste/ de ltar bsgom zhan lam sgom pa la brtson pa yin no/ /smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gis lam 6bsgom par bya'o7/ /smras pa/ tshangs pa mthong bas ma yin/thos pas ma yin/ dran pas ma yin/ rnam par rig pas ma yin/ thob pas ma yin/ mngon du byas pas ma yin te/ gang chos thams cad la mi sgom pa 'di ni lam sgom 8pa'o/ /smras pa/ lha'i bu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus kyi go cha sra ba bgos 9pa zhes bya/ smras pa/ tshangs pa byang chub sems dpa' gang chos gang la yang gcig pa 'am tha dad par yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus kyi go cha sra ba bgos 1 pa zhes bya'o/ /gang chos kyi dbyings ma 'dres pa'i phyir chos gang la yang 'byed par mi byed sbyor bar mi byed de/ chos kyi dbyings ma gtogs par kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba mi mthong ba 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i 1brtson 'grus rtsom pa'i mchog go/ /gang chos thams cad la bsal ba dang bzhag pa med pa 'di ni brtson 'grus com 1 pa'o/ /tshangs pa gang la lus dang ske/ ngag dang yid kyi rtsom dpa med pa 'di ni brtson 'grus rtsom 1 pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i bu phyir mi ldog pa la legs so zhes bya ba byin nas tshangs pa khyad par sems la bka' stsal pa/ tshangs pa lha'i bu 'di ji skad ston pa de de 5bzhin no/ /'di ni de'i 17brtson 'grus rtsom pa'i mchog ste/gang lus kyi 1 rtsom pa yang med/ ngag gi rtsom pa med/ yid kyi rtsom pa yang 59wa 218

med pa 'di ni brtson 'grus rtsom 1pa'i mchog go/ /tshangs pa ngas mngon par shes pa 'das pa'i dus na sbyangs pa'i yon tan yo byad bsnyungs pa 2thams cad yang dag par blang ba'i brtson 'grus brtsamasam kyang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ma bstan to/ /de bzhin du bla ma rnams la ldang ba dang / rim gro bya ba dang / dgon par gnas pa dang / mang du thos pa dang / sems can rnams kyi bya ba ci yod ces 4bya ba la kun tu 'gro ba'i brtson 'grus brtsams kyang nga 5lung ma bstan to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar lus dang / ngag dang / sems kyi rtsom pa la rab tu gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /tshangs pa nam nga tsholha'i bu 'dis ji skad du 7bstan pa'i brtson 'grus rtsom pa 2de lta bu dang ldan par gyur pa de'i 'og tu nga 9de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad kyis bram ze'i khye'u khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus na shākya thub pa zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /tshangs pa de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' lung bstan pa'i sa myur du thob par 'dod pas brtson 'grus rtsom pa 'di lta bu 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad la rtsom 1 pa med pa'i brtson 'grus 'di la brtsam 1par bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rtsom pa ma mchis pa'i brtson 'grus de gang lags/ bka' stsal pa/ tshangs pa gang dus gsum mnyam pa nyid dang ldan pa'i brtson 'grus rtsom pa'o/ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das dus gsum mnyam pa nyid dang ldan pa'i brtson 'grus rtsom pa gang lags/ bka' stsal pa/ 'di lta ste/ 'das pa'i sems ni zad/ ma 'ongs pa ni ma phyin/ da ltar byung ba la ni gnas pa 2med cing mi dmigs te/59—219

gang zad pa de ni dmigs su med do/ /gang ma byinamanya)pa de ni mi skye ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /de bzhin du gang da ltar byung ba de yang chos nyid kyis mi gnas so/ /chos nyid gang yin pa de yang ma skyes pa'o/ /gang ma skyes pa de ni 'das pa'ang ma yin/ ma 'ongs pa yang ma yin/ da ltar byung ba yang ma yin no/ /gang 'das pa'ang ma yin/ ma 'ongs pa yang ma yin/ da ltar byung ba yang ma yin pa de ni rang bzhin no/ /rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni ma skyes pa ste/ tshangs pa dus gsum mnyam pa nanyid dang ldan pa'i brtson 'grus rtsom pa de lta bu 'di ni lung bstan pa myur du thob par byed do/ /tshangs pa byang chub sems dpa' bzod pa de lta bu dang ldan pa ni chos thams cad gtong ba med pa'i sbyin pa la mos so/ /chos thams cad srung dab med pa'i tshul khrims la mos so chos thams cad rlom sems med pa'i bzod pa la mos so/ /chos thams cad rtsom pa med pa'i brtson 'grus la mos so/ /chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la mos so/ /chos thams cad rnam par mi rtog pa'o zhes shes rab la mos sol/ /de de ltar mos pas lhag par mi byed/ bri bar mi byed/ byed pa ma yin/rnam par byed pa ma yin no/ /sbyin pa yang sbyin par byed la de'ang rnam par smin pa la mi re bas so/ /tshul khrims kyang srung la de'ang sgro btags pa med pas so/ /bzod pa yang sgom la de'ang phyi nang stong pa nyid kyis so/ /brtson 'grus kyang rtsom la de'ang yongs su grub pa med pas so/ /bsam gtan la yang mnyam par gzhog pal de yang gnas pa med pas so/ /shes rab kyang sgom 6la de yang mtshan ma med pas so/ /tshangs pa byang chub sems dpa' bzod pa de lta 7bu dang ldan pa ni bya ba thams cad kyang ston la bya bas kyang mi gos so/ /de mi gos 59—220

pas chos thams cad la mnyam pa nyid thob cing rnyed pas kyang mi 'phrogs/ rnyed pa med pas kyang ma yin/ snyan pas kyang ma yin/ mi snyan pas kyang ma yin/smad 17pas kyang ma yin no/ bstod pas kyang ma yin/ sdug bsngal gyis kyang ma yin / bde bas kyang mi 'phrogs /so/ /de 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad las rnam par 'das te/ gnyis su dmigs pa'i sems dang bral zhing gnyis su med pa'i chos rtogs pa'i phyir khengs par yang mi byed / 'dud par yang mi byed/sdud par yangs5mi byed/ khong khro ba 6yang mi byed/ gnod par yang mi byed/kun nas gnod par yang mi byed/ rlom sems su yang mi byed/ bag med par yang mi byed/ kun nas bag med par yang mi byed do/ /sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir lta ba gnyis su ltung ba'i sems can rnams kyi don du snying rje chen po skyed 7nas ched du bsam na nas srid pa nye bar len te/tshangs pa gang 'di bdag med pa'i bzod pa rab tu thob pas sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po bskyed de/ skye ba 9yongs su 'dzin pa 'di ni brtson 'grus rtsom pa'i mchog yin no/ /brtson 'grus brtsam 1 pa bstan pa 'di bshad pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' stong phrag brgyad mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa skyes par gyur te/ de dag thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis thams cad ming gcig tu de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus brtan pa zhes bya bar sangs rgyas kyi zhing tha dad par der 1byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan to/ /de nas 'khor der tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po 'dug par gyur pa des bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste dper na/ gang klu chen po de dag ni 59—221

char 'bebs na rgya mtsho chen por 'bebs te/ sa phyogs gzhan du ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du skyes bu dam pa klu chen po dang mtshungs pa 'di dag kyang chos kyi char 'di 'dra ba 'di skyes bu dam pa mtsho chen po 1rgya mtsho lta bu 'di dag gi sems kyi rgyud la 'bebs te/ sems can gzhan dag la ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung ji skad zer ba de bzhin yin mod kyi klu'i rgyal po chen po de dag la ni gang gi phyir 'dzam bu nagling 'dir char pa mi 'bebs par 'gyur ba'i ser sna med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / 'dzam bu dagling gi 4phyogs kyis char pa'i rgyun shing rta'i srog shing tsam de dag mi bzod do/ /'od srung gal te klu chen po de dag gis 'dzam bu pagling 'dir char phab par gyur na des 'dzam bu tshogling 'di grong dang / grong khyer dang bcas/ ri dang brag dang ri bor bcas/ khor 7yug dang 'obs su bcas pa 'di lta ste/ rdza ma'i chus rgya shug gi lo ma bteg pa bzhin du bteg nas khyer bar 'gyur te/ de bas na klu chen po de dag 'dzam bu nagling 'dir char pa mi 'bebs so/ /'od srung de bzhin du skyes bu dam pa 'di dag la ni gang gi phyir sems can de dag gzhan la chos kyi char pa chen po mi 'bebs par 'gyur ba'i chos kyi ser sna med mod kyi 'on kyang 'di dag 9chos 'di lta bu dag gi snod du ma gyur te/ de lta bas na skyes bu dam pa de dag rgya mtsho lta bu'i 1 blo mchog dang ldan pa de dag la chos kyi char pa chen po 11'bebs so/ /'od srung 'di lta ste dper na char pa'i rgyun shing rta'i srog shing tsam bab pa de dag gis kyang rgya mtsho chen po bri ba yang med/ gang ba yang med do/ /'od srung de bzhin du skyes bu dam pa de dag bskal pa brgyad 1 chos nyan tam 'chad kyang chos gang yang bri 59—222

ba'am gang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste dper na rgya mtsho chen po der gling chen po bzhi'i klung sna tshogs nas gang chu 'bab pa de dag thams cad 'di lta ste/lan tshwa'i ror ro gcig par 'gyur ro/ /'od srung de bzhin du skyes bu dam pa 1de dag rnam grangs sna tshogs su chos bstan pa bshad pa dag thos ma thag tu 'di lta ste/ stong pa nyid kyi ror ro gcig tu mos par 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste dper na rgya mtsho chen po ni dag pa/ gtsang ba dri ma med pa/ gsal ba/ rnyog pa med pa yin te/ chu rnyog pa can 5mi 'dzin to/ /'od srung de bzhin du skyes bu dam pa de dag kyang dag pa/ gtsang ba/ dri ma med pa/ gsal ba ste/gnod sems dang / zhe snang dang / khro ba dang / 'khon 3du 'a dzin pa 4thams cad mi 'dzin to/ /'di lta ste dper na rgya mtsho chen po ni zab cing gting dpag dka' ba'o/ /de bzhin du skyes bu dam pa de dag kyang chos kyi tshul zab mo la rab tu zhugs shing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gting dpag dka'o/ /'di lta ste dper na rgya mtsho chen po ni chu tshad med cing rin po che'i tshogs dpag tu med pa'o/ /'od srung de bzhin du skyes bu dam pa de dag kyang shes rab tshad med cing chos rin po che'i tshogs dpag tu med do/ /'od srung 'di lta ste dper na/ rgya mtsho chen po rin po che sna tshogs kyi dbyings sol/ /'od srung de bzhin du skyes bu dam pa de dag kyang mngon par bsgrub ru pa sna tshogs kyis chos rin po che tshad med pa'i dbyings so/ /'od srung 'di lta ste dper na/ rgya mtsho chen po'i nang nas rin po che kha cig rin thang yod pa 6dang /kha cig rin thang med pa dang / kha cig mching bu lta bu dang rnam pa gsum 'byung ste / 'od srung de bzhin du skyes bu dam pa de dag sems can gyi dbang po ji lta 59—223

ba bzhin du chos ston pa na yang nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang / gang 'og ma theg pa chen po la sems kyi rgyud rnam par 'grol lo/ /'od srung 'di lta ste dper na/ rgya mtsho chen po ni sems can gcig gi ched du mi gnas so/ /'od srung de bzhin du skyes bu dam pa de dag kyang sems can gcig gi don du byang chub tu sems mi skyed do/ /'od srung 'di lta ste dper na/ rgya mtsho chen po ni mthar gyis gzhol/ mthar gyis 'bab/ mthar gyis babs3)pa'o / /'od srung de bzhin du skyes bu dam pa de dag kyang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gzhol/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'bab/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du bab pa'o/ /'od srung 'di lta ste dper na/ rgya mtsho chen po ni shi ba'i ro dang lhan cig mi gnas so/ /'od srung de bzhin du skyes bu dam pa de dag kyang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sems dang lhan cig mi gnas so/ /ser sna dang / ngang tshul ngan pa'i sems dang / gnod sems dang / le lo'i sems dang / brjed ngas pa dang / 'chal pa'i shes rab kyi sems dang lhan cig mi gnas so/ /bdag dang / sems can dang / srog dang / gang zag dang —/ skyes bur lta ba dang lhan cig mi gnas so/ /'od srung 'di lta ste dper nam/ bskal pas sreg par gyur pa'i tshe/ klung dang / chu bran dang / chu mig dang ske/ mtshe'u dang / rdzing bu dang / mtsho thams cad sngar skam napar 'gyur te/ phyis rgya mtsho chen po zad cing bskams par 'gyur ro/ /'od srung de bzhin du dam pa'i chos nub par 'gyur ba'i tshe nyi tshe bar spyod pa la zhugs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi dam pa'i chos sngar nub par 'gyur te/ phyis skyes bu dam pa blo gros rgya mtsho lta bu sangs rgyas kyi theg pa yang dag par 'dzin pa de 59—224

dag gi lag nas dam pa'i chos nub par 'gyur te/ yang 'od srung skyes bu dam pa de dag ni srog kyang yongs su gtong bar byed kyi dam pa'i chos yongs su gtong bar mi byed na/ 'od srung skyes bu dam pa de lta bu dag gi lag nas dam pa'i chos nub par 'gyur ba yod dam/ de dag gi dam pa'i chos nub par khyod kyis mis 1)blta'o/ /'od srung 'di lta ste dper na/ rgya mtsho chen po 3)nor bu rin po che rin po che thams cad 'dus pa zhes bya ba rdo rje tshogs kyi nor bu rin po che chen po sne zhig yod de / de nyi ma bdun shar nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du 'od zer byung yang rin po che de tshig par mi 'gyur te/ gang 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bar gyi ri5risangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan dag na rgya mtsho chen po yod pa der nor bu rinam6)po che de der 'pho bar 'gyur te/ 'od srung gang nor bu rin po che de rgya mtsho chen pos kyilas gzhan 8du ma 'phos pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir tshig par mi smyo 'gyur ba de ni gnas ma yin zhing go skabs med de1 / de ni gnas med do/ /'od srung de bzhin du skyes bu dam pa de lta bu de dag kyang dam pa'i chos yongs su zad par 'gyur te/1/ 'jig rten gnas par dam pa ma yin pa'i chos bdun byung ba'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan du 'pho bar 'gyur ro//bdun gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mu stegs can gyi gnas dang / sdig pa'i grogs pos yongs su zin pa dang / log pa'i sbyor ba dang / gcig la gcig 'tshe 12ba'i sbyor ba dang / lta bar gyur pa'i thib 1 po dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba 'joms par byed pa dang / ma thob cing mngon par ma rtogs pa ste/ dam pa ma yin pa'i chos bdun po de dag 'jig rten gnas par byung ba de na sems can rnams snod ma yin par shes nas skyes bu dam pa de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan 59wa 225

du 'pho bar 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / dam pa'i chos mnyan pa dang ske/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'bar ba dang yang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /'od srung 'di lta ste dper na/rgya mtsho chen po la brten cing sems can tshad med pa dag gnas so/ /'od srung de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' la brten cing sems can tshad med pa dag phun sum tshogs pa gsum la gnas so/ /gsum gang zhe na/ lha'i phun sum tshogs pa dang / mi'i phun sum tshogs pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /'od srung 'di lta ste dper na/ rgya mtsho chen po ni sems can 1dag gis btung bar mi nus so/ /'od srung de bzhin du skyes bu dam pa de dag gis 2gang chos bstan pa de dag kyang pha rol gyi rgol ba rnams kyis btung bar mi nus so/ /'od srung 'di lta ste dper na/ rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na 5sems can gnas pa de dag ni chu gzhan mi tshol gyi de nyid la 'thung ngo / /'od srung de bzhin du skyes bu dam pa de dag kyang gzhan gyi ngor lta bas chos kyi ro mi 'thung gi/ rang byung gi ye shes kyi chos kyi ro 'thung ngo / /de nas gnas brtan 'od srung chen pos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgya mtsho chen po'i gting ngam tshad gzung skab ni nus kyi nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis skyes bu dam pa de dag gi gting ngam tshad gzung ba tshoni mi nus te/ de bas na skyes bu dam pa de dag sems nam mkha' dang mtshungs zhes bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i snye klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 59—226

rgya (1)mtsho chen po rnams kyi gting ngam tshad ni gzung 5bar nus kyi nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dang / lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis )skyes bu dam pa blo gros lamachog rgya mtsho lta bu 5dang ldan pa de dag gi gting ngam tshad gzung ba 6ni mi nus so/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /ji ltar 7chog mi shes par chu chen gter/ /'bab chu thams cad kun gyi chu tshol ba/ /de bzhin de rnams 'di la chos tshol kyang / /rtag par chos kyis chog par 'gyur ba med/ /ji ltar ji snyed chu mang rab bsdus kyang ske/ /'di la rgya mtsho 'gribs shing gang 'gyur med/ /dam pa'i chos thos nas kyang chos kyi dbyings/ /shin tu 'phel shing 'grib pa namathong ba med/ /ji ltar dri med rgya mtsho chu sdud kyang / /rnyog pa can gyi 'bab chu der mi 'bab/ /de bzhin thub mkhas spyad pa spyod pa yang / /de dag rnam 9dag nyon mongs mi sdud do/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho chen po lus 'chang 1 bas/ /zab cing gting yangs pas na mi dpogs pa/ /de bzhin yon tan rgya mtsho 11ye shes kyang / /pha rol rgol ba rnams kyis dpag mi nus/ /ji ltar rgya mtshor 'bab 15pa'i 'bab chu rnamasal/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dag kyang ro gcig 'gyur/ /de bzhin rnam pa sna tshogs chos thos nas/ /de dag rnam par grol bar ro gcig 'gyur/ /ji ltar chu 'dzin rgya mtsho chen po ni/ /skye bo gcig gi don phyir mi gnas te/ /de bzhin byang chub tu yang zhugs pa dag /de dag 'gro ba kun la phan phyir zhugs//ji ltar rgya mtsho rin chen dbyings yin zhing / /de la 1 gnas nas nor bu rin chen 'byung / /de bzhin rin chen 'byung gnas sems can mchog /de dag las ni rin chen gsum 'dir 'byung / /ji ltar rnam par mi rtog rgya mtsho na/ /59—227

rtag par rin chen rnam pa gsum 'byung ste/ /de bzhin de dag chos rnams ston pa yang / /theg pa gsum gyis sems can dag par 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'bab pa dang ni 'gram nyid nas/ /rgya mtsho chen po mthar gyis gzhol bas1)ltar/ /de bzhin sems can mchog rnams kun mkhyen gzhol/ /sems can rab tu dgrol phyir rtag tu brtson/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho ro dang mi gnas te/ /de dag gi ni ma 'dres chos 'di yin/ /de bzhin byang chub mchog la zhugs pa yang / /dman pa'i theg pa dang ni gnas mi byed/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho las byung rin chen ni/ /rin chen sdud ces bya ba sra bsngags pa/ /sreg pa'i bskal pa byung yang mi tshig ste / /de yang 'jig rten 'jig tshe gzhan du 'gro/ /de bzhin dri ma med pa'i chos 'jig tshe/ /brtson 'grus mchog ldan de dag 'bad cing 'dzin/ /snod min 'jig rten chos min 'dod rig nas/ /mkhas pa rgyal ba gzhan gyi drung du 'gron / /nam zhig sreg pa'i bskal pa byung gyur te/ /chu mig mtsho dang lteng ka skam par 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho 'dir ni phyisam )nas skam par 'gyur/ /stong gsum chen po 'di yang rab tu 'jig /nyi tshe'i spyod la nye bar gnas pa yi/ /'di la mchog tu bya ba'i chos nus pa/ /de tshe 'dir ni sems can mchog chos 'di/ /lus dang srog kyang bor nas srung bar byed/ /bde gshegs 'das na'ang rtag par bag med pas/ /de dag rnams la chos 'di mi 'jig go5/ /de ltar de rnams bsam pa'ang rnam par dag /chos la gnas shing spyod pa rtag par spyod/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho sems can tshad med gnas/ /sems can gcig gi don du mi 'jug pa/ /de bzhin 'jig rten thams cad rnam grol phyir/ /grags pa chen po 'di dag rab tu 'jug /'jig rten khams 'di rgya mtsho ji snyed pa/ /ma 59—228

lus par ni tshad rnams shes rung yang / /rgyal ba de dag kun gyi spyod pa ni/ /dgra bcom rang rgyal dag gis kyi)shes mi nus/ /ma lus phyogs kyi nam mkha'i dbyings rnams kyang / /mchog rnams kyi ni tshad gzung 2nus srid kyi/ /nam mkha' bas kyang lhag pa de dag gi/ /ye shes tshad ni nams kyangashegazungakhumi nus / /byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus brtul brtan (5)zhing / /gang dag 'jig rten ma lus dgrol ba'i phyir/ /rgya che yangs pa'i sems rab gzhol byas pa / /'od srung de dang 6)mtshungs med ga la lhag /de dag rin chen 'byung gnas rgya mtsho 'dra/ /de dag bsod nams yin la bsod nams zhing / /de dag dpyad 7)pa'i rgyal po sman 27pa'i mchog /sems can yun ring na ba thar bar byed/ /de dag gnas yin skyabs dang dpung gnyen te/ / skyob pa 9)sgron ma de bzhin 'od byed pa/ /skye bo ldongs pa rnams kyi mig skyed pa/ /de thob pas na de dag bdud rtsi thob/ /de dang de dag chos kyi rgyal mchog 'bar/ /de rnams brgya 3 dbyin don mang sems pa ste/ /tshangs pa bsam gtan bzhi la gnas pa yin/ /de dag tshangs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor 1lha/ /de dag ded dpon mkhas pa 'dren pa ste/ /log pa'i lam du gnas la lam ston pa/ /de dang de dag bdud 'jomasam12dpa' bo ste/ /sems can dam pa byang chub snying por gnasam/ /de dag chos dkar tshad med zla ba bzhin/ /de dag 'od zer mngon 'phags nyi ma 'dra/ /sprin lta bur yang tshad med blo sgrogs shing / /'jig rten gsum na bdud rtsi'i char pa 'bebs/ /de dag seng 1 ge lta bur 'jigs skyon med/ /glang po che ltar shin tu dul ba'i sems/ /de dag ri rab ri bo 'dra mtshungs te/ /de dag pha rol rgol bas mi thub bo/ /de dag rnam par dang 59wa 229

ba chu bzhin te/ /rtag tu bsnyen 1)par dka' ba me dang 'dra/ /de dag rlung ltar rtag tu chags named cing / /sa dang 'dra bar tha ba rab tu spangs/ /gnod sems nga rgyal tha ba phrag dog bral/ /de dag rtsi yi shing ltar rtog pa med/ /'jig rten chos rnams brgyad pos rim gos shing / /de dag tshul khrims rnam dag pad ma bzhin/ /de dag u dum bās ra'i me 5tog ltar/ /dge zhi zhing bskal pa bye bar sgra thos dka'/ /de dag rkang gnyis gtso la byas pa gzo/ /de dag sangs rgyas rigs la gnas par brtson / /de dag snying rje che zhing brtul zhugs 8brtan/ /byams la gnas dang dga' la mngon par 'phags/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la btang 9stoms zhing / /rtag tu rgyal ba dag gi nor rnams tshol / /de dang de dag sbyin pas khyad par song / /ye shes tshul khrims la yang rab tu gnas/ /de dag bzod pa'i stobs kyis gcig tu dpa'/ /brtson 'grus rags 1 shing rtag tu mthu dang ldan/ /de dag bsam gtan 11mngon par shes la mkhas/ /de dag tshad med zhing du 'phrul gyis 'gro/ /thub pa dam mchog la yang chos nyan cing / /ji ltar thos pa dag kyang ston 12par byed/ /ji ltar 'di mos rnam 1 par 'grol ba yang / /skye bo dag gi spyod pa de dag shes/ /ji ltar mos pa mkhas shing rtogs pa ste/ /nan tan snying por byed cing mu stegs thobal/ /'di rnams tshogs pa las ni 'di skye zhes/ /de dang de dag chos kun rab tu shes/ /de dag rkyen la mkhas shing rtog 1 pa ste/ /mtha' gnyis lta ba spangs shing mnyam la dga'/ /chos 'di gang nas 'ongs shing 15gar 'gro zhing tsha//de dag chos la tshul bzhin rnam par lta/ /chos kun 'ong ba 1 ma yin byung 12ba yin19ske/ /gnas pa chos nyid mtshungs par rab tu shes/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dus 59wa 230

byas brdzun du mthong / /de lta de ltar snying rje can du 'gyur/ /mi bden 1 nyon mongs skye bo sdug bsngal te/ /de dag thar bar bya phyir spyad dpa spyod/ /nga dang nga yi zhes ni rnam brtag danas/ /byis pa mi mnyam pa la brtson pas spyod/ /chos de yang dag ma yin shes nas ni/ /lta ba spangs pa'i 4phyir ni chos la spyod/ /bdag med bdag tu mi sdug sdug par te/ /sdug bsngal bde bar mi rtag rtag par yang / /sems log so so'i skye bo rnams la ni/ /'khor ba'i sngon gyi mtha' yang yod ma yin/ /de dag log pa'i sbyor ba 5de shes nas/ /'di la sems can med dang gang zag med/ /gang la bdag sdug rtag bde med pa yin/ /yang dag sbyor ba la yang rnam par sgom6/ /'od srung de yi yon tan 'di brjod pa / /sa yi )rdul phran ji bzhin phyogs tsam ste/ /byang chub sems dpa' de yis spyod yul gang / /de dag ye shes bsngags pa mtha' yas so/ /stong gsum 'jig rten mchod pa ci 9yod pa/ /kun gyis byang chub sems dpa' de la mchod / /de las 1 lhag par yang ni 11mchod 'os te/ /rgyal ba'i thugs sras dag ni phyir mi ldog /gang rnams sangs rgyas 'gyur bar brtson ldan pa12/ /de dag gis ni nga 1snyedang ma byon dang / /gang yang mya ngan 'das pa'i rgyal ba dang / /ma lus phyogs bzhugs rim gror rte byas par 'gyur/ /de nas tshangs pa khyad par sems kyis/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal ci rinas chos kyi rnam grangs 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe lnga brgya 16tha ma la rab tu spyod pa dang / rgyas par 1 'gyur bar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la gsol ba thob shig /de skad ces smras pa dang / 'jam dpal 59—231

gzhon nur gyur pas tshangs pa khyad par sems la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshangs pa de ji snyam 1/du sems/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la chos gang dene bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlab 45)par bya ba'i chos gang yang de bzhin gshegs pas yongs su bstan tam/ smras pa/ 'jam dpal de ni ma yin no ska/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ tshangs pa de lta bas na 'di la brjod pa med pas na chos thams cad byin gyis ma brlabs zhedapa ste/ de ni 46)nub par mi 'gyur zhing bsrung bar bya ba ma yin no/ /tshangs pa gang chos gang la yang byin gyis brlabs 7par 'dod pa de ni nam mkha' byin gyis brlabs 8par 'dod do/ /tshangs pa byang chub sems dpa' gang chos gang yang khas len na de ni chos smra ba de 9)ma yin no / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' smra ba thams cad las phyir ldog 1 pa ni rtsod pa med pa lhur byed pa ma 11yin no/ /tshangs pa byang chub sems dpa' gang dag 'di snyam du 'khor 'dir chos bstan to 12snyam du sems na de dag la chos thos pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ thos pa med pa 1 ni chos thob 1 pa'o / /smras pa/ 'jam dpal thos pa med pa ni chos thos pa'o/ /zhes bya ba ci las bsams 15te de skad zer/ smras pa/ tshangs pa khomig dang / rna ba dang ske/ sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyis thos pa med pa ni chos thos pa ste/ gang skye mched de dag ni 1 gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang /ro dang / reg dang / chos la mi 'dzin pa de dag ni chos thos pa'o/ /de nas 'khor de nas lha'i bu stong phrag sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dge slong stong phrag lnga dang ske/ dge slong ma sum 1 brgya dang / dge bsnyen brgyad brgya dang / dge bsnyen ma brgyad brgya de dag thams cad kyis 'jam dpal gyis bstan pa 'di 59wa 232

thos nas mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob ste/ tshig kyang 'di skad du 'jam dpal de de bzhin no/ /ji skad smras pa de bzhin te/ thos pa med pa ni chos thos pa'o zhes 'dzer to/ /de nas tshangs pa khyad par sems kyis 3)bzod pa rab tu thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyed kyis rdo chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos sam/ smras pa/ tshangs pa thos pa med pa'i tshung rgyas thos so/ /smras pa/ khyod kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ji ltar shes / smras pa/ ji ltar shes pa med pa dang / rnam par shes pa med pa de ltar ro/ /smras pa/ khyed kyis pachos gang rab tu thob pas bzod pa rab tu thob par 'gyur5no/ /smras pa/ chos thams cad rab tu thob pa med pa'i phyir rol/ /smras pa/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ji ltar rtogs par bya/ smras pa/rtogs par bya ba med pa'i tshul gyis so/ /smras pa/ chos bstan pa 'di khyed kyi ri tshomangon sum 7yin nam/ smras pa/ tshangs pa nachos thams cad bdag dang gzhan med pa'i phyir mngon sum yin no/ /de nas 'khor de nyid du lha'i bu dri ma med pa'i 9tog ces bya ba 'dus par gyur pa des tshangs pa khyad par sems la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshangs pa gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di las chung ngu na nyan 1 ripar 'gyur ba de dag gal te de bzhin gshegs pas lung ma bstan kyang kho bos de dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshangs pa chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni 'bras bu dang sa bon chud mi gzon 1pa'o/ /'phags pa yang dag par zhugs pa thams cad kyis yongs su bzung ba'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yang dag par bskyed 12pa'o/ /bdud dang phyir rgol ba tshar gcod pa'o/ /bar du gcod pa thams cad dang 59—233

bral ba'o/ /dang ba skye bar byed pa'o/ /dad pa dang ldan pa rnams dga' zhing mgu bar byed pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyis shin tu yongs su gzung 1ba'o / /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis legs par bsrungs pa'on/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni gcig tu nges pa ste phyir mi ldog pa'o/ /chos kyi rnam dgrangs 'di ni byang chub kyi snying po la mi slus ba'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams 5kyi bden pa'i 'byung gnas sol/ /chos kyi rnams (tshogangs 'di ni chos kyi 'khor lo bskor 7ba'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni 'gyod pa rnams sel bar byed pa'o/ /chos kyi 8rnam grangs 'di ni 'phags pa'i lam rnam par sbyong ba'o9/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni thar bar 'dod pa rnams kyis legs par thos pa'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni gzungs 'dod pa rnams kyis legs par bzung 1 ba'o/ /chos kyi 11rnam grangs 'di ni bsod nams 'dod pa rnams kyis legs par rab tu bstan pa'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni chos 'dod pa rnams kyis legs par bsrung ba'o12/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni mya ngan las 'das par 'gro ba'i phyir grangs med pa'o//chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni pha rol gyi 1lhargol ba dmigs 1 pa can gyis mi 'phrogs 5pa'ospyo/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni sbyin par 'os pa rnams dang 'thun pa'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni mkhas pa rnams dga' bar byed pa'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni lta ba ngan pa dang bral bas shes rab skyed ma pa'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni gti mug 'joms par byed pas ye shes bskyed pa'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni yi ge'i tshig nges pas shin tu nges pa'i tshig go/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni 'bru 'brel bas legs par bstan pa'o snye / /chos kyi rnam grangs 59—234

'di ni don dam pa yang dag par ston pas don yang dag par bskyed 1)pa'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni chos brjod pa rnams kyis na yongs su ma btang ba'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni shes pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis ma bor ba'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni nor 'dod pa rnams kyi gter ro/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni kun tu gdungs pa rnams yongs su gdung ba med par byed pa'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni byams pa la gnas pa rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid skyed 5pa'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni le lo can rnams kyi 4brtson 'grus skyed 45pa'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni brjid ngas 6pa rnams kyi bsam gtan bskyeda'7)pa'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni shes rab 'chal ba rnams la snang bar byed pa'o/ /tshangs pa chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la 8ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad shin tu legs par gnas so/ /de nas lha'i bu des chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i bsngags pa bstan pa na stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos 9so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang lha'i bu de la legs so/ /zhes bya ba byin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshangs pa khyad par sems kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das lha'i bu 'dis sngon gyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dag las sngon chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos sam bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshangs pa lha'i bu 'dis sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig phrag 1 drug cu rtsa bzhi las chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos te/ tshangs pa lha'i bu dri ma med pa'i tog 11'di bskal pa brgya stong phrag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis na 'jig rten gyi khams rin chen 12ldan du de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 1 bkod pa zhes bya bas/ 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gang yang de'i bar du sangs rgyas 59—235

'byung ba de dag thams cad la yang mnyes par byed par 'gyur/ bkur stir byed par 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag las chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang thos par 'gyur ro/ /tshangs pa dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang ske/ dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za gang dag gis kyang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la bzod pa rab tu thob pa de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che bkod pa'i sangs/ rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams rin chen ldan du skye bar 'gyur 1ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha'i bu dri ma med pa'i tog nagis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang bdag ni byang chub mi 'tshal / mi smon/mngon par mi dga'/ mngon par ma chags/ mi dmigs/ mi sems/ mi rtog rnam par mi rtog na/ ci'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la lung bstan / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i bu 'di ltar skyes bu la la zhig gis rtswa dang / shing dang / yal ga dang / lo ma dang / 'dabs ma dag mer 5bcug nas 'di skad du rtswa dang / shing dang / yal ga dang / lo ma dang ske/ 'dab rnam dag ma tshig ces smras na/ de de'i dbang gis mi 'tshig pa 7yin no/ /lha'i bu de bzhin du 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' byang chub la mngon par mi dga'/ mngon par ma chags/ mi dmigs/ mi 'dod/ mi smon / mi sems/ rnam par mi rtog kyang sangs rgyas thams cad lung ston te/lha'i bu 'on kyang byang chub sems dpa' gang byang chub la mngon par mi dga'/mngon par ma chags/ mi dmigs/ mi 'dod/ mi smon/ mi sems/ rnam par mi rtog pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams /lung ston to/ /de nas 'khor 59—236

der lha'i bu lnga brgya tsam gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang byang chub la mngon par mi dga'/ mngon par ma 3)chags/ mi dmigs/ mi 'tshal/ mi smon/ mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog nan/ ci'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung mi bstan/ de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus steng gi phyogs na steng gi bar snang la sangs rgyas stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi mthong ste / de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis de dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha'i bu de dag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas 'di skad du byang chub sems dpa' gang byang chub la mngon par mi dga'/ mngon par ma 4chags/ mi dmigs/ mi 'dod/ mi smon/ mi sems/ mi rtog rnam par mi rtog pa de byang chub tu lung bstan par 'gyur ro zhes legs par gsungs pa 'di 5ni ngo mtshar te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag 6gis steng gi 7phyogs na sangs rgyas stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi mthong ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad bdag cag la bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston to/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang slad ma'i dus lnga brgya tha ma la 'dzam bu nagling 'dir chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rab tu spyod pa dang / yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ba dang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo gang dag go cha 9chen po bgos pa dag gi rna lam du gda' bar 'gyur ba dang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag bdud kyi las skyes shing byung ba rnams kyi ༷dbang du mi 59—237

mchi ba dang / de dag la bdud dam bdud kyi ris kyi lha dag gis glags rnyed par mi 'gyur ba dang / chos kyi rnam grangs 'dis yongs su bzung zhing go cha chen po bgos te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yongs su mi nyams 1par byin gyis brlabs napar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal de bas na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di byin gyis brlabalo pa dang ske/ yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / grul bum 'bebs pa zhes bya ba'i rig pa dang sngags kyi tshig 'di bshad kyis nyon cig /rig 5pa dang sngags kyi tshig de bcangs pas rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo chos smra ba de lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / grul bum rnams kyis yongs su srung ba rab tu thob ste/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag lam mam lam log par song ngam/ gtsug lag khang du song ngam/ gnas khang du song ngam/'chag pa la zhugs sam/ 'khor gyi nang du song yang rung ste srung bar byed do/ /spobs pa skyed par byed/ dran pa dang / blo gros medang / rtog 8)pa'i stobs bskyed pa nye bar sbyor te/ de la pha rol gyi rgol ba'am/ phas kyi 9)dgra glags tshol ba dag gis glags kyang rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /de dran zhing 1 shes bzhin du ldang bar 'gyur/ 'chag par 'gyur/ 'dug par 'gyur/ nyal bar 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal de la rig pa dang sngags kyi tshig de dag gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ ud dhu re/ dhu dhu re/ man te/ tsa ti ma/ go tsa ri11/ shrī la 59—238

li / hi li mi li/ thi li/ thi mi li/ hu 'u/ hu tha/ hu (spru/ e bad te/ be ta she / kha kha re/ kha re/ kha ra ke/ ā0)san ne/ dza ga ti/ ma hi le/ ma nu ṣa/ ta ne ma na se ba ra gan dhe/ sarba ru ti(5/ ra bās na/ba ga teng/ sin dhu le/ na mo bud dhe bhyaḥ55/ tsa di ra 6)tre/ na mo dharmā ya ni rga ta ni/ na maḥ(7) rma(37 ya/ bā gyi (ta pā pe/ byu pa shānta ni1rte/ sarba pā pā 11 ni mi tri kyi me / sarba budhel bhyaḥ sa tya ni ra de sha brahma pa tho/ ma hā ṛ nyi ṣi giḥ/'a pra shāsta tam tra tiṣṭhan ti/ / sarba bhu ta grwa ha/ na maḥ sarba budhe 1 bhyaḥ sidhyantu me mas79pa dā swā hā/ 'jam dpal rig pa dang sngags kyi 3 tshig 'di byang chub sems dpa' gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la brtson pa/ rtag tu shes bzhin dang ldan pa/ mi rgod pa/ khengs pa med pa/ sems ma g.yengs pa/ kun du spyod pa 21gtsang ba/ stsogasatshan pa dang bral ba/ chog shes pa/ bas mtha'i gnas malamanyal mngon par dga' ba/ 'du 'dzi nyung ba/ lus dang sems dben pa/ byams pa dang snying rje la mngon par dga' ba/ chos la dga' zhing mos pa/ bden pa'i tshig la rab tu gnas pa/ mi slu ba/ nang du yang dag 'jog la mngon par dga' ba tshul bzhin sa yid la byed pa la brtson pa/ tshul bzhin 3gem yin pa yid la byed pa dang bral ba/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang yo byad bsnyungs pa la mngon par dga' ba/ rnyed pa dang 2snyom rnyed pa la sems mnyam pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa la mngon du phyogs pa/ 'khor bas 'jigs shing skrag pa/ sdug pa dang mi sdug pa la sems mnyam pa/ 'du shes sna tshogs dang bral ba/ lus dang srog 'dor ba dang / dngos po thams cad la mi lta ba/spyod pa dang cho ga phun sum tshogs pa/ tshul khrims dang sdom pa la mngon par 59wa 239

dga' ba/ bzod pa dang des pa mang ba/ ngan du zer ba bzod pa'i 1)rang bzhin can/ brtson 'grus brtsams 5)pa/ sems can thams cad kyi bya ba ci yod ces bya ba la brtson pa/ bzhin 'dzum pa/ khro gnyer dang bral ba/gsong por smra ba/ nga rgyal bcom pa/ des pa/ 'grogs na bde ba/ de lta bu'i spyod pa la rab tu gnas pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mos 'jam dpal sngags kyi tshig 'di rab tu gdon par bya'o/ /'jam dpal de ltar na chos smra ba de tshe 'di nyid la stobs bskyed pa bcu rab tu 'thob bo/ /bcu gang zhe na/ mi brjed pa'i chos nyid pas dran pa'i stobs bskyed pa dang / chos rab tu 'byed pa la mkhas pas blo gros kyi stobs bskyed pa dang / mdo sde'i tshul khong du chud pas rtogs pa'i stobs bskyed pa dang / sdom pa dang / spyod pa mi gtong bas dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa dang / bdag dang gzhan srung bas ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod pa'i stobs bskyed pa dang / shes rab yongs su rdzogs pas thos pa'i stobs bskyed pa dang / thos pa thams cad yongs su 'dzin pas gzungs kyi stobs bskyed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis 3yongs su bzung bas spobs pa'i stobs bskyed pa dang / mngon par shes pa lnga rab tu thob pas zab mo'i stobs bskyed pa dang / myur du thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs pas mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa'i stobs bskyed 4pa ste/ 'jam dpal spyod pa la zhugs pa'i chos smra ba gang rig pa dang sngags kyi tshig 'di rab tu 'don pa de ni stobs bskyed pa de bcu rab tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /rig pa dang sngags kyi tshig bstan pa 'di bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa'i tshe rgyal po chen po bzhi skrag cing ba spu langs par gyur 5te/ g.yog brgya stong phrag du ma dang /59—240

bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong nas phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 1)te thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi po 'di nadag ni rgyun du zhugs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' sgrub par bgyid pa ste/gnyen bshes dang bcas/ 'khor dang bcas pas rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo chos smra ba dang chos ston pa 4gang mdo sde 5'di lta bu 'di 'chang ba dang /klog pa de dag la bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po bzhis bsrung ba dang /bskyab pa dang sba bar bgyi'o/ /de dag grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ ljongs sam / ljongs kyi phyogs gang na gnas kyang rung / khyim pa'am/ rab tu byung ba yang rung ste/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po bzhi stobs dang bcas 'khor dang bcas pas rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag gi rim gro bgyi bar bdag cag spro'o/ /bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / spro ba dang / spobs pa dang ske/ gzhan gyis gnod par mi bgyi zhing mi gtse bar bgyi ba'i slad du bdag cag spro'o/ /bcom ldan 'das phyogs gang na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rab tu spyod par 'gyur ba'i sa phyogs der dpag tshad brgya kho ra khor 6yug tu lha'am/klu'amal/ gnod sbyin nam/ grul bum gyis glags mi rnyed do/ /de nas rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes pos tshigs su bcad pa 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag la bu dang gnyen bshes 7dang / /bran dang 'khor rnams ci mchis pa de dang bdag cag grogs bcas pas/ /bdag po de dag rim gro bgyi/ /de nas rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang gis tshigs su bcad pa 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag ni chos kyi rgyal po'i sras/ /chos las skyes pa chos kyi sprul/ /khyod kyi sras 859—241

gang byang chub tu/ /zhugs pa de dag rim gro bgyi/ /de nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung gis tshigs su bcad pa 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sangs rgyas gsungs pa'i mdo sde 'di/ /gang dag 'dzin par 'gyur ba ti rnams/ /de dag phyogs bcu rnams su yang / /bdag gis kun tu bsrung bar bgyi/ /de nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bus tshigs su bcad pa 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gang dag byang chub phyir brtson pa/ /de la ci 'dra 'os pa yi/ /de 'dra'i mchod par bgyi ba 2ni/ /sems can kun gyis mi nus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu bden pa'i zla ba zhes bya ba des rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i gdugs gsol nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di skad ces gsol to/ /de bzhin gshegs las bdag nyid kyis/ /chos kyi rnam grangs gzung bar bgyi/ /pha rol la yang bstan par bgyi/ /bdag gi bsam pa de 'dra'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag sems dang / /sngon gyi spyad 4pa ci 'dra mkhyen / /ji ltar bdag gi sems 'dud pa/ /bdag ni 'jig rten rnam 5'dren gyur/ /sangs rgyas dpag med skyob pa la/ /bdag gis gdugs 'di phul ba yis/ /bdag ni thub pa khyod 6'dra bar/ /spyi gtsug bltar yang 7mi gda' na'agyur/ /sangs rgyas skyes bu dam pa yang / /bdag gi byams pas bltas pa yis/ /yongs su dag pa'i mig thob ste9/ /rgyal ba ma pham blta bar bgyi / /ye shes pha rol phyin pa yi11/ /ston pas de nas lung bstan 12te/ /khyod ni 'di nas phyi dus na/ /dga' ldan du yang skye bar 'gyur/ /dga' ldan nas ni shi 'phos nas/ /rgyal ba byams pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /bskal pa stong phrag nyi shur ni/ /mchod pa byas nas 'byung bar 'gyur/ /khyod ni rab tu byung 59—242

nas kyang / /tshangs par spyad ti pa rab spyad de/ /bskal pa bzang 'dir gang byung ba/ /bdag po de dag mthong bar 'gyur/ /thams cad la yang mchod byas te/ /tshangs par spyod pa spyad nas ni/ /bskal pa bye ba drug cu na/ /de nas khyod ni sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni legs brgyan pa/ /rin chen gdugs zhes bya bar ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' sha stag la/ /khyod ni chos rnams ston par 'gyur/ / tshe yis tshad ni bskal par 'gyur/ /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i dam chos kyang / /ma 'dres bskal pa phyed du gnas/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin g.yog brgya stong phrag du ma dang bcas pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang chos smra ba mdo sde 'di 'chang ba de dag bsrung ba dngas / yongs su bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /bsnyen bkur dang rim gro yang bgyi'o/ /gang na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yi ger 'dri ba'am/ klog pa der ci nas kyang chos smra ba de'i stobs dang mthu dang chos kyi mtshams sbyor ba spobs par 'gyur bar ci )bdag 'khor dang bcas te chos nyan du mchi'o/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi bu sbed byed ces bya ba des do shal rin po che thams cad kyis spras pa de bzhin gshegs pa la phulas5nas tshigs su bcadamachi pa 'di dag gsol to/ /thub pas7)bdag 'dir mngon sum 8ste/ /ji ltar khyod kyis sngon spyad pa/ /de bzhin bdag kyang sangs rgyas kyi/ /ye shes tshol bas bsgrub par bgyi/ /khyod kyis sngon chad ma stsal cing / /yongs su ma btang ci ma mchis/ /bdog pa thams cad gtong ba yi9/ /bdag kyang rjes su bslab 1 par bgyi/ /khyod kyi mdo sde 'di yang ni/ /'jig rten mgon las mngon du blangs/ /yang dang 53—243

yang du bshad par bgyi/ /bdag po khyod la bgyis par gza1kyi/ /mdo sde 'di la su dga' ba/ /de dag bdag gi ston pa 'dra/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas chos 'tshal bas/ /de la rtag tu rim gro bgyid/ /dam pa'i chos rnams yongs su bsrung —/ /mgon po nyan thos mi nus te/ /phyi dus 'jig napa chen po'i tshe/ /bdag gis yongs su bsrung bar bgyis/ /mgon po bdag kyang dbugs dbyung gsol / /lha rnams the tsom gcad cadu gsol/ /thub pa khyu mchog khyod 'dra bar / /ji srid yun gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /kun mkhyen ye shes mkhas pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pas de lung bstan/ /nga 5ni ci 'dra de 'dra bar/ /khyod kyang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /bskal pa bye ba phrag stong dang / /bskal pa bye ba brgya yi ( tshe/ /'jig rten du ni sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /ming ni ye shes 'byung zhes bya/ /byang chub zhi ba thob nas kyang / /bdud rnams rab tu btul nas ni/ /sems can bye ba brgya stong rnams/ /byang chub la yang 'god par 'gyur / /de nas mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag bsam gtan la gnas pa yang btang ste/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang dag par ston pa de la chos nyan du mchi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ brgya byin dang tshangs pa ni 'di las skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag la bsnyen bkur dang rim gro bgyi bar spro'o/ /de dag ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis rim gro bgyi ba dang mchod par 'os pa lags so / /de nas tshangs pa mi mjed kyi bdag pos bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa 'di skad ces gsol to / /dge slong dang ni dge slong ma/ / dge 59wa 244

nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po stobs chen la sogs pa nam mkha' lding gi 'khor mang po rnams dang / lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan la sogs pa lha ma yin gyi 'khor mang po rnams dang / mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa la sogs pa mi'am ci'i 'khor mang po rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po lag bzangs 1ril sogs pa lto 'phye chen po'i 'khor mang po rnams dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin lha'i bu stong phrag mang po'i 'khor nadang bcas pa dang / mi mjed da kyi bdag po tshangs pa tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu 'bum phrag du ma'i 'khor dang bcas pa dang / rgyal po gsal rgyal 'khor stong phrag du ma dang bcas pa dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'khor dang bcas pa dang thabs cig catu bzhugs te/ de dag la sogs pa 'khor sgrubazhi 6po rnams kyis yongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas 7)te chos ston to/ /de'i tshe na 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa/ 'khor de nyid du 'dus par gyur te 'dug go/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las naphyir mi ldog pa 9rab rtsal sems 1 kyang 'dus par gyur te 'dug go/ /de nas lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis 'khor phal po che de 'dus par rig nas stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs 11te/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 12logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa 1 chen po la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtsams 1 59—272

pa thams cad la brtson 'grus brtan pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsod nams dag gis0)mngon par 'phags pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ye shes kyis chags pa ma mchis par spyod pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyis ((mun pa dang bral ba rnams lags/ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'khor rnams kyi nang du 'jigs pa dang bral ba rnams lags/ ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thos pas don la rton ྅pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten gyi (4)tshul gyis chos la rton 5pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis 6gsungs pa bzhin du smra ba rnams lags/ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can rnams la chos smra ba rnams lags/ ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mngon par shes pa rnams kyis 7rimangon par 'phags pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bdud thams cad kyis thub par dka' ba rnams lags/ ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blos nagating dpag dka' ba rnams lags/ ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad kyis mi 9gos pa rnams lags/ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 10gting dpag dka' zhing zab mo la spyod pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos ston pas dbang po la mkhas pa rnams lags11/ ji ltar na byang 59—273

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos la dbang sgyur〈nye)bas dbang phyug tu gyur pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bgyi ba thams cad la slob dpon du gyur pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad du kha na ma tho ba ma mchis shing yon tan rnam pa thams cad dang ldan pa rnams lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i bu rab rtsal sems la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab rtsal sems legs so legs so/ /lha'i bu khyod byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa/ 'jig rten gyi yongs su 'dren pa/ snying rje chen po dang ldan pa/ bskal pa grangs med pa nas go cha bgos pa/ brtson 'grus 2shin tu brtan pa/ ded dpon chen po/sems can dpag tu med pa'i don byed pa/ sems can dpag tu med pa thams cad thangam nobade ba la rab tu 'god pa la mkhas pa/ yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa rnams kyi don du de bzhin gshegs pa la yongs su zhu ba ni yang khyod legs so/ /lha'i bu de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon las yid la zung shigs5dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi neyon tan gyi khyad par de dag dang gzhan dag kyang 'thob par 'gyur ba ngas khyod la bshad par bya'o/ /lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis bcom ldan 'das de ltar 'tshal lo zhes gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na theg pa chen po la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ thabs la mkhas pas mngon par bsgrub 59—275

pa'i shes rab dang / snying rje chen pos mngon par bsgrub pa'i byams pa dang /don dang chos kyis mngon par bsgrub pa'i spobs pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag gi rnam pas mngon par bsgrub pa'i mngon par shes pa lnga po dag ste/lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na theg pa chen po la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa rnams yin no/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ thabs la mkhas pa mngon par sgrub par byed pa yi/ /mngon sum shes rab rtogs par khong du chud gyur cing / /thams cad skyabs 1phyir snying rje chen po yangs pa la/ /gnas pa'i byams pa mngon par sgrub par byed gyur (5la / /don dang chos la shin tu mkhas par 'gyur bsngo yi/ /so so yang dag rig la spobs pa thob gyur cal/ /byang chub lam la mngon shes dag gis rnam rtse na/ /des ni gzhan gyi dring la 'jog par mi 'gyur ro/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na/ brtsam 5pa thams cad la brtson 'grus brtan pa rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ phyir mi ldog pa'i brtson 'grus dang / bsam pa dag pa'i brtul ba dang / byang chub la 'dun pa drag po dang ldan pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su bsgrub pa la yid yongs su mi skyo ba dang ldan pa ste/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na brtsam 6pa thams cad la brtson 'grus brtan pa yin no/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ brtson 'grus brtan zhing rab tu gnas pa 7med gyur cing / /bsam pa rnyog pa med cing yongs su dag gyur la / /sangs rgyas ye shes don phyir 'dun pa grags 8ldan zhing / /sangs rgyas chos rnams 'dod cing rtag tu yang 9mi skyo/ /gang la chos bzhi rgya chen khyad par 53—276

de yod pa/ /de ni byang chub lam du mngon 'byung brtan 'gyur zhing / /byang chub yan lag lag mthil bzhag pa bzhin gyur la/ /ring po mi thogs 'jig rten gsum gyi chos rgyal 'gyur/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na bsod nams dag gis mngon par 'phags pa rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 'doms par byed pa dang / sems can gang dag byang chub tu sems ma bskyed pa de dag byang chub tu sems bskyed du 'jug pa dang / sprul pa lta bur dus gsum yongs su bsngo ba dang / byang chub kyi tshosems dang ma bral bas dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad skyedas pa mngon par 'du byed pa ste/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan pa'o/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ mkhas pa gang dag shes rab pha rol phyin 'doms shing / /byang chub zhugs pas byang chub sems 'dzin 'jug byed pa/ /gang dag byang chub zhugs pas dus gsum yi rang zhing / /yid dang ma bral sprul 'dra byang chub 'dod byed pa/ /dge ba gang yin cung 4zad byed pa thams cad ni/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid sems la rten par byed pa yin / /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na ye shes kyis chags pa med par spyod pa rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/shes pas byis 5pa'i bya ba rnams byed cing / nga rgyal gyis byas pa rnams mi byed pa dang / chos thams cad rkyen las 6rag las shing byin gyis rlob pa med snye la gang zag dang bral bar shes pa dang / stong pa nyid spyod yul du gyur cing /sems can thams cad mi gtong ba'i bsam pa dang ldan pa dang / chags pa thams cad las yang dag par 'das shing skye mched drug yongs su shes pa srung 859—277

ba ste/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ shes pas las byed de dag nga rgyal yod min zhing / /brten la mkhas pa yin zhing de dag lta 1med la/ /stong nyid spyod yul de dag sems can mi gtong5bzhing / /chags pa kun las 5'das shing phyi nang gnas pa ni / /chos mchog bzhi po de la shin tu rab gnas pa/ /shes pas pha rol phyin cing chags med spyod pa yin/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na shes rab kyi75)mun pa dang bral ba rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ thos pas ngoms pa med cing tshul bzhin la rab tu sbyor ba dang / zang zing med pa'i sems kyis chos ston pa dang / chos kyi dbyings dbyer med pa gye shes par bya ba'i phyir nyon mongs pa thams cad la sgyu ma lta bur so sor rtog pa dang / tshul gcig la 'jug pas thams cad kyi 'jug pa la 'jug pa ste/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ de dag thos (mtsholams ngoms med tshul bzhin rtogs59)byed cing / /de khomanyam ston cing klog 'dzin rnyed pa tshol mi 11byed/ /nyon mongs sprin 'dra sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur blta/ /chos nyid tha dad mi byed de dag tshul gcig 'jug /che 12bdag chos bzhi de brten khyad par thob 12'gyur zhing / /shes charab sgron 'dras dmun bsal zla ltar 'jig rten rgyu/ /lha'itsha bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na 'khor rnams kyi nang du 'jigs pa dang bral ba rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ thos pa thams cad 'dzin pa'i gzungs thob pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi the tsom 1 3gcod pa'i spobs pa thob pa dang / sems can thams cad la bdag med pa ston pa'i snying rje chen po dang / bdud dang nyon mongs pa dang bral ba mngon par shes 59—278

pa'i ye kyi shes kyi go cha bgos pa ste/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ thos kun chud mi za bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs thob cing de dag spobs ldan sems can som nyi gcod par byed/ /snying rjes chos 'di thams cad bdag med ston byed cing / /mngon shes shes pa'i go bgos bdud kyis mi nyams la/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi de dag gis 'jug na/ /'khor kun nang du song yang de la 'jigs pa med/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na thos pas don la rton rin)pa rnams yin te / bzhi gang zhe na thos pas thams cad mi 'dzin pas sku thos pa dang mi ldan zhing ske/ sgrub pa nyams pa'i byis pa thams cad yongs su spong ba dang / yi ge dang ske/ sgra dang / skad dang / tshig gi lam thams cad mngon du rnam par shes par bya ba'i phyir/ brag ca na)dang mtshungs pa nyid du khong du chud pa dang /don 'dod pa nyid kyi phyir/ thos pa yongs su tshol zhing dga' dgur 46)bya ba'i phyir ma yin pa dang / brjod du med pa'i don la 'jug cing / brjod pa'i don ma yin pa ste/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ji tsam mang du thos kyang don 7la mi rtog pas/ /byis 8pa thos dang mi ldan rtag tu sgrub chos nyams/ /srid gsum sgra skad dbyangs dang tshig lam gang yod pa/ /brag ca(9)'dra bar de las don ldan sgra thos nas/ /don nyid rtogs shing 1 dga' mgur nyes kun phyir mi 'jug /chos nyid 'di ni don mchog yin te brjod du med / /'di ni don dang sgra skad thos par gyur pa las/ /'gro ba rnams su 'gro bar byed cing 'gro bar 'gyur/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na 'jig rten gyi tshul gyis sna chos la ston pa rnams yin 59wa 279

te1ske/ bzhi gang zhe na/ bre mo gtam byed pa rnams la chos ston pa dang / skye bo phal po che 'dus pa dag la 'chi ba rjes su dran pa dag dun/gtong ba chen po dag la rjes su yi rang zhing byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba dang / 'du 'dzi thams cad la dben par gzhol ba ste/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ gang tshe skye bo mang po'i dbus su son / gyur pa/ /der ni mkhas pas chos kyi gtam la 'jug par bya/ /skye bo mang po 'dus (zhi)par gyur pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /'chi bar 'gyur ba'i 'du shes rnam par bsgom56)par bya / /des ni bag yod gzhan gyi gtong ba rnam lnga yi/ /gtong la yi rangs 97)byas nas byang chub bsngo bya zhing / /gang tshe 'du 'dzi dag dang phrad par gyur pa'i tshe / /der ni dben par gzhol nabar rab tu 'dod par bya/ /lha'i 9bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 1 chos bzhi dang ldan na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis gsungs pa bzhin du smra ba rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ byang chub kyi sems mi gtong ba dang / thos pa bsgrub pa snying por byed pa dang / ji skad smras pa de bzhin du byed pa dang / rang bzhin gyis bdag med pa la 'jug pa ste/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ nyam nga 11gnod par gyur kyang byang chub sems mi gtong / /de dag skyob pa'i chos thos sgrub pa snying por byed/ /bka' 12blo bde 'thun 1 ji skad smras pa de bzhin byed/ /mkhas pa de dag chos kun rang bzhin bdag med 'jug /de ltar brtson pa'i shes ldan smras bzhin 1 byed 'gyur zhing / /rtag brtson mi 'dor rjes 'thun bdag med ci yang med/ /rtag tu snyan pa'i phreng ba phyogs bcur grags 'gyur zhing / /de ltar chos smra de dag chos kyi shes pas 59wa 280

'phagasal/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na sems can rnams la chos smra ba rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/bdag nyid bsgrub pa la tiganas shing sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang /bdag nyid dul ba dang / bsrung ba nadang / grol ba dang / btul (ba dang ske/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das shing sems can gzhan dag dul bar bya ba dang ske/ bsrung ba dang / dgrol ba dang / gdul ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las bzla ca ba'i phyir chos ston par byed pa dang / bdag nyid yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsam pa nges par gyur cing / sems can rnams kyang theg pa chen po la rab tu 'god par byed pa dang / bdag nyid chos 'dod cing /chos 'dod pas gzhan dag la yang 5ston par byed pa ste/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ bsgrub pa snying por byed cing 'gro la chos ston la/ /dul bsrung tsilegs btul shin tu mya ngan 'das gnas 7kyang / /gang dag ma dul ma bsrungs nam btul mya ngan 'das9/ /ma 'das de dag chos kyi dkon mchog 'byor bar 'dzud/ /de dag byang chub sems la bsam pa nges gyur cing / /theg pa de la 'gro ba rnams kyang 'god 1 par byed/ /rtag tu chos 'dod 11don ldan bla ma gus byed cing / /sems can rnams la de dang 'thun pa'i chos rnams ston/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na mngon par shes pa rnams kyis mngon par 'phags pa rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ yang dang yang du tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi'i 12gnas pa dang / rtag par rgyun du rab tu dben par gnas pa dang / chos zab mo la bzod pa dang / lus dang sems mnyam pa nyid du shes pa ste/ chos 59—281

bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa dag la rtag tu rab gnas shing / /dben par gnas pa la yang dga' ba skyed byed la1/ /shes pas zab mo'i bzod lasarsā)nges pa thob gyur cing / /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems dang ldan par gyur pa ste/ /de ltar mngon par brtson pa'i 'jig pa med pa rnams/ /mngon shes lnga po dag gis mngon par 'phags gyur cing / /de dag sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyan sngar 'dug 'dra la/ /sems can mang po rnams kyang yongs su smin byed 'gyur/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na bdud thams cad kyis thub pa zhe dka' ba rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ stong pa nyid kyi rnam pas mngon par bsgrub pa'i bsam gtan bzhi dang / sems can thams cad mi gtong ba'i snying rje chen po dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyunam5kyimi gcod pa'i brtson 'grus dang / thabs la mkhas pa 5)mngon par bsgrub pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug ste/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/mtshan 7med stong pas nges pa'i bsam gtan bzhi bsgomatsha zhing / /sems can yongs su skyabs 9phyir rtag tu snying rje ldan/ /dkon mchog gsum rgyun mi gcod brtson 'grus thob gyur cing / /kun tu thabs ldan pha rol phyin pa drug la 'jug/de ltar spyod mkhas blo ldan che bdag yid gzhungs pa/ /de dag bdud bzhi dag las yang dag 'das gyur cing / /bdud kyi lcags kyus zin pa'i 'gro ba mgon med rnams/ /mya ngan 'da' bar 'gro ba'i lam la 'god par byed/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na blos gting 1 dpag dka' ba rnams yin te/ bzhi gang 1nyazhe na/ chos zab mo'i tshul 59—282

la 'jug pa dang / rtag tu don dang ldan zhing bsnyen par dka' ba dang /rtag tu yid byung zhing chos sems par byed pa dang / 17sangs rgyas kyi ye shes sgrib pa med pa la sems kyis nges par rtogs par byed pa ste na/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ zab mo'i chos kyi tshul la zhugs par gyur pa dang / /rtag tu don dang ldan zhing bsnyen par dka' gyuralasal/ /rtag tu yid byung chos la bsam pa zhugs gyur cing / /sems kyis nges par rtogs par byed pa 3)gang yin pa'i/ /mkhas pa theg pa che la brtan pa parab gnas pa / /blo rnams dag gis gting dpag dka' bar rab 'gyur ri7zhing / /chags pa med pa'i ye shes yang dag sgrub byed pa/ /de phyir blo rnams dag gis gting dpag dka' ba yin/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad kyis mi gos pa rnams yin te / brgyad 8)gang zhe na/ rnyed pa dang / snyan pa dang / bstod pa dang /bde bas khengs pa med pa dang / ma rnyed pa dang / mi snyan pa dang / smad pa dang ske/ sdug bsngal gyis zhum pa med pa dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir phung po rnams la yongs su spyod par byed pa dang / phung po yongs su shes pa srung zhing dben par lta ba ste/ chos bzhi 9po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ rnyed dang snyan dang bstod dang bde ba kun thob kyang / /de dag la ni nam yang 1 khengs par 'gyur ba med/ /ma rnyed mi snyan smad dang sdug bsngal thob gyur kyang 11/ /de dag pad ma bzhin du chags med 'jig rten spyod / /sems can smin par bya phyir phung po yongs spyod cing / /phung po sgyu ma gsog 'dra ya ma brlar shes pa/ /sems can phan bde'i / don du nyana'ajig rten 53wa 283

spyod byed kyang / /'jig rten chos kyis mi gos tshul khrims spos ngad ldan/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na gting dpag dka' zhing zab mo la spyod pa rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ bdag la bdag med pa dang / sems can la sems can med pa dang / chos dben pa dang / shes pa chags pa med pa ste/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ bdag la bdag med nyid du yongs su shes gyur cing / /sems can sems can med par rjes su rtogs gyur la/ /chos rnams dben pa nyid du yongs su shes gyur cing / /mkha'am1la lag bzhin shes rab chags pa yod min pa'i/ /dpa' 2rnams zab mo dag la yongs su spyod byed la/ /spyadamasapa med la rtag tu spyod par byed gyur cing / /'dzin dang kun 'dzin kun dang rnam par bral gyur pas/ /sems can dag pa de dag de phyir gting dpag dka' / /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na chos ston pas dbang po rnams cal mkhas pa rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/mngon par shes pa thob pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa shes pa dang /shes rab rno ba dang / sngon gyi smon lam rnam par dag pa ste/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ mngon par shes pa rnams ni rab tu thob gyur cing / /shes pas so so yang dag rig pa 5mi zad gyur/ /rtag tu shes rab rnon por gyur cing sngon yang ni/ /yang dag bsags pa yongs su dag pa thob gyur pa/ /sems can rnams kyi dbang po yongs su shes byas nas/ /de dang 'dra ba'i chos rnams yongs su ston par byed/ /de dag bstan pa 'bras bu med pa ma yin te/ /de phyir mya ngan 'das nas mya ngan 'da' bar byed/ /lha'i 59—284

bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na 'dus ma byas dang ma 'dres pas rnam par thar pa'i sgor zhugs pa rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ stong pa nyid spyod yul du gyur cing / lta ba'i 'ching bas bcings pa'i sems can rnams thar bar byed 17pa dang / mtshan ma med pa la gnas shing rnam par rtog pa spyod pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar byed pa dang ske/ smon pa med pa la gnas shing narisems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir / bsam bzhin du skye ba len pa dang / thabs la mkhas shing shes rab kyi ri nges par byung ba ste/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/stong nyid spyod yul de dag ltas bcing 4grol byed cing / /mtshan med gnas shing sems can 'di dag yongs smin byed/ /smon pa med la gnas shing sems can smin bya'i phyir/ /bsam bzhin skye zhing gang du 'dod pa der skye 'gyur/ /shes rab thabs kyis nges byung rnam thar sgor gnas kyang / /'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings ni dus min thob mi byed/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na lhag pa'i nga rgyal can tshar gcod pa'i phyir snrel zhir bsgrub pa la mkhas pa rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ chos kyi dbyings kun nas sgo yang dag par shes pa dang / chos thams cad sgrib pa med par mos pa dang / kun tu rtog pa'i rtsa ba las byung ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams yongs su shes pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i rang bzhin can gyis 5chos thams cad la nem nur med pa ste/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste / sems mnyam chos kyi dbyings su nges par byung gyur cing / /de dag rnams kyis sgrib pa 'ga' yang mthong mi 'gyur/ /nyon mongs kun tu rtog pa'i 59—285

rtsa las rab byung bar/ /shes nas de las snrel zhir kun tu ston mi byed/ /chos 'di thams cad rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa dang / /ma skyes ma 'gag7)ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa yin/ /de dag kun mkhyen yongs btsal mya ngan 'das gyur nas / /lhag pa'i nga rgyal can dag tshar gcod byed pa yin/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na las kyi bya ba thams cad kyi rgyu la mkhas pa rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ longs spyod chen po'i rgyu sbyin pa mi spong ba dang / mtho ris su skye ba'i rgyu tshul khrims mi spong ba dang /shes rab chen po'i rgyu thos pa mi spong ba dang bral ba'i rgyu sgom pa mi spong ba ste chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ longs spyod che rgyu sbyin pa mi spong de'i 'bras de/ /mtho ris skye rgyu natshul khrims thob cing de'i 'bras de/ /shes rab nyon mongs 'joms rgyu thos pa de'i 'bras de/ /rnam grol rig rgyu sgom par byed cing de 'bras de/ /rgyu bzhi de la rtag brtson mkhas pa de dag ni/ /byang chub snying por dbang bskur 'bras phyir nyin mtshan spyod/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na lta ba'i rnam pa dang bral zhing ske/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la mkhas pa rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ chad par smra ba ma yin pa dang / rtag par smra ba ma yin pa dang / ma rig pa byung na rga shi'i bar du 'byung bar lta zhing / bdag tu lta bar mi byed pa dang ske/ ma rig pa 'gags na rga shi'i bar du 'gags par lta zhing srid pa 'gog par yang mi byed pa ste/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste / nam yang rtag par mi lta chad par ltung mi byed/ /des ni chos rnams rkyen byung byed pa po dang ni/ /tshor ba po med rirang bzhin rnam par dag par shes/ /59—286

ma rig rtsa las rga shi'i bar du 'byung 'gyur ba1)/ /rgyal ba kun gyis gsungs te de 'gags rgyu dang ni/ /rkyen zad de phyir phyin na/cad na/skye mi 'gyur zhes gsungs / /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i thabs la mkhas pa rnams (4 yin te/bzhi gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems canasar thams cad la rag las par lta 6)ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba yang pa dag par bsagasam pa la skyo ba med pa dang ske/ 'khor ba'i sgo nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i sgo yongs su tshol ba dang /sems can rnams kyi mos pa ji lta ba de lta bu'i mos pa'is59/thabs kyis nyams su myong bar byed cing / nyon mongs pa rnams kyis ma yin pa ste/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ sangs rgyas byang chub kho'adi ni sems can rnams la rten11/ /dge ba sogs shing 12'dod pas yongs su skyo ba med / /'khor ba'i sgo nas mya ngan 'das pa yongs tshol zhing / /sems can ji bzhin mos pa thabs kyis yongs su shes/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na sems can thams cad kyi nye bar 'tsho ba rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ longs spyod mi zad pa dang / chos 1 ston pa mi zad pa dang / mngon par shes pa thob pa dang / sems sa ltar mnyam pa ste / chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ de dag rnams kyi longs spyod rtag tu mi zad cing / /rtag tu chos kyi 1 mi zad rgya mtsho 'dra ba yin / /de dag mngon shes lnga po mi zad rtag mi g.yo/ /rtag tu dran ldan bsam pa sa dang 'dra ba yin/ /mnyam med byang chub phyir ni yang dag zhugs gyur cing ske/ /mya ngan ma 'das gang la chos rnams de yod pa/ /de dag 'gro ba kun 59—287

gyi nye bar 'tsho 'gyur zhing / /byang chub mchog phyir myur du nges par 'byung bar 'gyur / /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na 'jig rten thams cad mngon par 'du bar 'gyur ba rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi 1gnas pa dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis bsdus napa dang / bden pa bzhis shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob pa ste/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste / tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi po dag gis gnas byed cing / /bsdu ba'i dngos po dag la rtag tu dga' byed 4la/ /bden pa bzhi po dag la 'jigs (5med dpa' bo rnams/ /'gro bas ri mo byas shing mchod pa byas par 'gyur/ /so so yang dag rig pa'i pha rol son gyur cing / /'chang cadang klog pa dag la rtag tu brtson gyur la/ /pha rol bde bar gyur pa'i bde bas mgu byed na/ /de phyir de dag yid du 'ong zhing sdug par 'gyur/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na srog chags thams cad kyis bsngags par 'gyur ba rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ thos pa dang tshul khrims dang ldan zhing / tshul 'chos pa med pa dang / des shing 'grogs na bde ba dang /dben pa la dga' shing 7dbang po bsrung ba nadang / bdag nyid bde ba la lhag par chags pa med cing rtag tu kha na ma tho ba la lta 9ba ste/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de 1 la 'di skad ces bya ste/ thos pa'i yon tan thob cing tshul khrims pha rol son/ /tshul 'chos med cing rtag tu des la brtul zhugs 1 bzang ske/ /nags dang nags 'dab 1 gnas shing dbang po sdom byed la/ /dran ldan bdag bde mi ltos kha na ma tho ste da/ /gang la rtag tu dge ba'i yon tan de 59wa 288

yod pa/ /de dag rtag tu sems can phan phyir brtson 'grus zhing / /de dag sems can don yang rtag tu byed 'gyur la/ /de dag rtag tu byang chub phyir ni yid gzhol 'gyur/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na dge ba'i spyod pa (1thams cad la smad pa med pa rnams yin te/bzhi gang zhe na/ dad pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa dang / snying rje chen po phun sum tshogs pa dang / theg pa chen por dayongs su dbasngo ba la mkhas pa rnams yin te/ bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ de dag dad dang ldan la brtul ba brtan ldan zhing / /de dag brtson 'grus mthu dang stobs dang ldan pa yin/ /'gro ba kun la byams dang snying rje che ldan zhing / /byang chub ched du yongs su bsngo la mkhas pa ste/ /de phyir dge ba kun la smas 5pa yod min zhing / /zla ba nya ba'i zla ba mkha' la skar ma yi/ /tshogs kyi dbus na gnas pa rnam par mdzes pa dag /yang dang yang du dge ba kun la rnam 'phel 'gyur/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na shes rab dag la rgya mtsho lta bu rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ ji skad smras pa de bzhin du byed pa dang / sgrub pa snying por byed pa dang / blo rab tu gnas pa dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa rdo rje ltar brtan pa ste/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/mkhas pa de dag ji skad smras pa de bzhin byed/ /de dag sgrub pa snying por byed cing blo rab gnas/ /gang dag brtson pa de dag rdo rje lta bu yi/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa brtan pa dag dang ldan par 'gyur/ /mkhas pa gang dag chos bzhi de dag ston byed 6pa/ /de dag rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen sten snye byed cing / /59wa 289

dam bcas rnams 1la snying por byedamatsho par 'gyur ba dang / /rtag tu sangs rgyas gsungs yang 'dzin par byed pa yin/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na chos la dbang sgyur cabs dbang phyug tu gyur pa rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ ye shes kyi stobs can rnams yin zhing nyon mongs pa'i stobs can rnams ma yin pa dang / sems la dbang sgyurasnyib rnams yin zhing bdud kyis dbang sgyuramachi rib ma yin pa dang / gzungasamanyadang spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin pa dang / 'bras bu yod par chos ston pa rnams yin te/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/de dag ye shes stobs ldan nyon mongs dbang mi 'gro/ /shes rab stobs kyis blun spangs lta 9rnams kun du 1 bral/ /sems la dbang sgyur 11byed cing bdud bzhi spangs gyur la/ /spobs pa brtan par gyur cing gzungs kyis 'khrugs yogepa med/ /de dag ston pa 'bras bu med par mi 'gyur te/ /de phyir myur du dbang phyug nyid dang ldan par 'gyur/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na bya ba thams cad la slob dpon du gyur pa rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ nga rgyal med pa dang / bla ma la gus pa dang /bag yod pa dang / 'dun 1 pa drag po ste/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ nga rgyal med cing bla mar gus pas gnas gyur la/ /kun nas bag yod byang chub mchog la 'dun drag cing / /bsam pa thag rṣa pas smon cing rtag tu drang gyur la/ /slob dpon dpe mkhyudas med pa rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur/ /mkhas pa 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i don mkhas shing / /tshul dang tshul ma yin pa'i tshamakhas pas 1 brtan pa rnams/ /'jig rten kun 59wa 290
