mdza' thams cad rtogs par khong du chud/ /de phyir 'gro bas nyu)spyi bor thal sbyar de la 'dud/ /lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' (na chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing / yon tan rnam pa thams cad dang ldan pa rnams yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ mngon par shes pa'i yedzabashes kyis rnam par brtses stab dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 5)dgongs pa'i spobs snyo/pa dang / dge ba thams cad dang mi 'bral zhing bag chags dang bral ba dang / dge ba'i chos thams cad dang ldan zhing dbang bskur 7ba thob pa ste/ chos bzhi po de dag dang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ sems can dag pa rgya chen mngon shes shes pas brtseg / /bde gshegs kun gyis dgongs pa mkha' 'dra'i spobs dang ldan/ /brtson 'grus thogs smyo med mi dge bag chags kun spongs 7shing / /dge dang ldan zhing dbang bskur 11thob par gyur pa ste/ /chos rnams de dag la ni rab tu gnas gyur pa/ /de dag kha na ma tho med pa'i yon tan ldan/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bzhi pa bsgrub pa 'di bstan pa na lha dang mi rnams las srog 12chags sa ya 1 nyis 'bum gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyi khri lnga stong gis ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /lha dang mi rnams kyi skye dgu las srog chags 'bum ni chos rnams la mchos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag go/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yang rnam pa drug tu rab tu g.yos shing / 'jig rten thams cad snang ba chen pos khyab par yang 7gyur to/ /lha rnams kyis kyang lha'i me tog gi char rab tu phab cing / lha'i sil 1 snyan dag gi sgra yang byung 1259—291

bar gyur to1/ /klu rnams kyis kyang mu tig dmar po dang / klu'i me tog gi char rab tu phab po/ /lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am cisanadang ske/ lto 'phye chen po dang / gnod sbyin rnams kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das la lha'i mchod pa dag gis mchod pa byas / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor rnams kyis kyang / a la la chos/ a la la chos/ a la la chos zhes kyilan gsum ched du brjod pa ched du brjod nas mchod pa chen po dag kyang byas so/ /de nas lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal bcom ldan 'das kyis chos sum cu ra rtsa gnyis po nede dag gi don dang tshig rnam par gtan la 'bebs 7pa bstan par na bka' stsal gyis90/ 'jam dpal khyod kyang chos sum cu 1 rtsa gnyis po 11de dag gi don dang tshig rnam par gtan la dbab pa de la spobs par gyis 12shig /'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 12chen po theg pa chen po la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams gzhan gyi rkyen gyis mi 'gro ba de lta na/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtsam pa thams cad la brtson 'grus brtan pa rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams nyon mongs pa thams cad nges par 'joms par byed pa de lta na/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtsam pa thams cad la brtson 'grus brtan pa rnams yin 59—292

no / /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsod nams dag gis mngon par 'phags pa rnams yin/'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams chos kyi dbyings mi g.yo ba rjes su rtogs pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsod nams dag gis mngon par 'phags pa rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ye shes kyi chags pa med par spyod pa rnams yin/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams yul thams cad la chags par mi byed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sem sa dpa' chen po ye 1shes kyi chags pa med par spyod pa narnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi mun pa dang bral ba rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag par shes par byed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi mun pa dang bral ba rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'khor rnams kyi nang du 'jigs pa dang bral ba rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams chos thams cad rnam par phye na mi rnyed par byed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'khor rnams kyi nang du 'jigs pa dang bral ba rnams yin no/ /59—293

lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 1/thos pas don la rton pa rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams chos thams cad brjod du med par shes par byed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thos pas don la rtonam5)pa rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa / 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten gyi tshul gyis chos la rton dpa rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams chos kyi dbyings zhi ba nyid du shes par byed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten gyi tshul gyis chos la rton 5pa rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis gsungs pa bzhin du smra ba rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams sgra thams cad la rten 6par mi byed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis gsungs pa bzhin du smra ba rnams 7yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can rnams la chos smra ba rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams smra ba thams cad las ldog par byed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can rnams la chos smra ba rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji 59—294

ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mngon par shes pa rnams kyis mngon par 'phags pa rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams chos thams cad las g.yo bar mi byed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mngon par shes pa rnams kyis mngon par 'phags pa rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bdud thams cad kyis thub par dka' ba rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams stong pa nyid rjes su rtogs par bya ba'i phyir nyon mongs pa nyid byang chub yin par yongs su tshol bar byed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bdud thams cad kyis thub par dka' ba rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blos gting dpag dka' ba rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyis gting rtogs par byed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos 1blos gting dpag dka' ba rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad kyis mi gos pa rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams 'jig rten na spyod kyang 'jig rten gyi chos rnams kyis gos par mi 'gyur ba de lta na/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad kyis mi 59—295

gos pa rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gting dpag dka' zhing zab mo la spyod pa rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams bdag la bdag med pas sgyid lug par mi 'gyur ba de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gting dpag dka' zhing zab mo la spyod pa rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos ston pas dbang po la mkhas pa rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dbang po drug gis dbang po thams cad la lta bar byed par 1de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos ston pas dbang po la mkhas pa rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'dus ma byas dang ma 'dres pas rnam par thar pa'i sgor gnas pa rnams yin/'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams sgo thams cad nas thar pa ston par byed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'dus ma byas dang ma 'dres pas rnam par thar pa'i sgor gnas pa rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lhag pa'i nga rgyal can tshar gcod rnapa'i phyir snrel zhir bsgrub pa la mkhas pa rnams yin/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams 'khor ba las mya ngan las 'das pa tshol zhing lta bar byed la/ mya 59—296

ngan las 'das pa las kyang 'khor ba tshol zhing lta 1)bar byed pa de lta na/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lhag pa'i nga rgyal can tshar gcod pa'i phyir snrel zhir bsgrub pa la mkhas pa rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po las kyi bya ba thams cad kyi rgyu la mkhas pa rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams chos thams cad mi 'pho bar lta bar byed pa de 2lta na/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po las kyi bya ba thams cad kyi rgyu la mkhas pa rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lta ba'i rnam pa dang bral 3zhing / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la mkhas pa rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams chos thams cad bdag po med par shes par byed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lta ba'i rnam pa dang bral cazhing rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la mkhas pa rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can yongs su smin par bya ba 5dag la thabs la mkhas pa rnams yin / 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams 'jig rten gyi tshul la smod par mi byed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dag la thabs mkhas pa rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam pa yongs su 53—297

dag pas brtul zhugs 1)grub pa rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis ( smras pa/lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams rtogs pa nyid byang chub yin par shes par byed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam pa yongs su dag pas brtul zhugs grub pa rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhe 'gras pa'i sems med cing bzod pa'i /stobs dang ldan pa rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams chos thams cad gtan du yongs su mya ngan las 'das par shes par byed/ lta bar byed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhe 'gras pa'i sems med cing bzod pa'i stobs dang ldan pa rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyi pha rol tu son pa rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams chos thams cad pha rol las mthong bar byed pa de lta na/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyi pha rol tu son pa rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyi nye bar 'tsho ba rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ca)chos kyi dbyings mi zad pa rab tu rtogs par byed pa de lta na/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyi nye bar 'tsho ba rnams yin no/ /lha'i 59—298

bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten thams cad mngon par 'du bar 'gyur ba rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams mi snang ba'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad 1snang ba de lta na/lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten thams cad mngon par 'du bar 'gyur ba rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' snye chen po srog chags thams cad kyis bsngags par 'gyur ba rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams chos 'ga' yang lenam par mi byed/ spong bar mi byed pa de lta na45)/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po srog chags thams cad kyis bsngags par 'gyur ba rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dge ba'i spyod pa thams cad la smras 6)pa med pa rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams chos thams cad 7)nam mkha' dang mtshungs shing 'dra bar shes par byed 8pa de lta na/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dge ba'i spyod pa thams cad la smras 9pa med pa rnams yin nol/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab dag la snying por gyur pa rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams chos kyi dbyings kun tu 'byed par mi byed pa de lta na/ lha'i bu byang chub sems 59—299

dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab dag la snying por gyur pa rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos la dbang sgyur bas dbang phyug tu gyur pa rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams bsam du med pa sems pas sems thams cad shes par byed pa de lta na11/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos la dbang sgyur nabs dbang phyug tu gyur pa rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bya ba thams cad la slob dpon du gyur pa rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams tshul gcig gis tshul thams cad shes par byed cing ske/ tshul thams cad kyis kyang tshul gcig shes par byed pa de lta na/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bya ba thams cad la slob dpon du gyur pa rnams yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing / yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa rnams yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams chos thams cad gnyen po med par rtogs nas chos 'ga' yang bsgrub par mi byed/ chos 'ga' yang sel bar mi byed pa de lta na/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing yon tan rnam pa thams cad dang ldan pa rnams yin no/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas bstan pa 'di bshad pa na byang chub sems dpa' lnga khri brgyad stong gis mi skye ba'i 59— 300

chos lung bstan pa la bzod pa thob par gyur to1/ /lha dang mi rnams kyi skye dgu bdun khri nyis stong ni chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag go/ /srog chags 'bum lhag tsam gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la mchod pa'i phyir/ lha rnams kyis kyang steng gi bar snang las lha'i me tog gi char dag mngon par rab tu phab bo/ /thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor rnams kyis kyang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas bstan pa 'di thos nas yi nacirangs pa dang / dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas tshig 'di skad ces bdag cag cig 3gis kyang chos de dag thob par gyur cig /'jam dpal gzhin nur gyur pa'i spobs pa ji lta ba de calta bu'i spobs pa mi chod pa yang thob par gyur cig ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 5kyang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'jam dpal khyod kyis chos rnam par gtan la dbab pa bstan nepa 'di legs par smras te legs so legs so zhes bya ba byin to7// //bam po gnyis pa/ de nas lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal ci khyod kho bo las chos kyi 8dgab pa 'dod dam/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu 'di skad du khyod chos kyi 9dgab pa 'dod dam zhes zer ba ni/ lha'i bu legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba 'di la chos kyi dgab pa zhes bya ba ni sred pa dang 'dod pa 11spangs pa yin te/ chos 'di ni so sor rtogs napa med pa'i phyir 'dod pa med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni mig gi lam las yang dag par 'das pa'i phyir ltar mi snang ba yin no/ /chos 'di ni mngon par grub pa med pa'i phyir ma byas pa yin 59—301

no / /chos 'di ni yul drug dang ma 'dres pa'i phyir mi mthong ba yin no/ /chos 'di ni sems dang / yid dang / rnam par shes pa dang bral ba'i phyir bdag gi ba med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni gtan yongs su ma grub pa'i phyir gzung ba med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni yul med pa'i (yul du 'gro ba'i phyir gzhi med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni rang bzhin gyis dben pa'i phyir zag pa med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni sngon gyi mtha' rnam par dag pa'i phyir 'ong ba med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni phyi ma'i mtha' rnam par dag pa'i phyir 'gro ba med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni da ltar byung ba rnam par dag pa'i phyir gnas pa med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni brtag gcing sel ba dang bral ba'i phyir rtsol ba med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i phyir mnyam pa med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni gnyen po med pa'i phyir mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni bdud kyi yul thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa'i phyir g.yo ba med pa dang /rlom sems med pa dang / ma brtags capa dang / rnam par ma brtags 5pa dang glu/ rnam par ma bsgrubs pa dang / kun tu ma bstan pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni skye ba dang 'jig pa dang bral ba'i phyir blang ba med pa dang / dor ba med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni chos kyi dbyings su yang dag par gzhol ba'i phyir gnas pa med par gnas pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni yang dag par ma byung ba'i phyir dbyer med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni spros pa dang bral ba'i phyir rab tu spyod pa med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni rang bzhin gyis nye bar zhi ba'i phyir spros pa dang bral ba yin no/ /chos 'di ni rnam par rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir nye bar zhi ba yin no/ /chos 'di ni phas kyi tshorgol ba thams cad nges par 59—302

bcom pa'i phyir rnam par rtag hu)pa med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni 'dod pa'isko kyi'adod chags kyi rdul gedang bral ba'i phyir shin tu 'phags pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni stong pa nyid kyi phyir stong pa med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni nges par ma brtags9)pa'i phyir mtshan ma med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni rnam par shes pa mi gnas pa'i phyir smon pa med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni rtsa ba yongs su chad pa'i phyir mi gnas pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni grogs med pa'i phyir mi rten pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni mi rten pa'i phyir mi g.yo ba yin no/ /chos 'di ni gzodas5)ma nas rnam par dag pa'i phyir bdag med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni gtan mngon par grub pa med pa'i phyir sems can med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni gzod ma nas ma byung ba'i phyir rtag pa med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni gzod ma nas ma skyes pa'i phyir ma byung ba yin no/ /chos 'di ni mtshan nyid dang bral ba'i phyir ma skyes pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni mtshan nyid thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir mtshan nyid med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni gzod ma nas yang dag par rgyun chad pa'i phyir zhi ba yin no/ /chos 'di ni gzod ma nas nye bar zhi ba'i phyir yang dag par 6kyirgyun chad pa med pa yin no/ /chos 'di ni mi phyed pa dang mi snang ba'i phyir nam mkha'i mtshan nyid lta bu yin na / lha'i bu chos de lta bu la chos kyi dgab pas85de 9lta bu zhig yod/ lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal chos 'di'i dgab pa sna ni kun tu 'phro ba med pa yin no/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu legs so legs so/ /ji skad smras pa de bzhin te/ chos 'di'i dgab pa 11ni gang la lus dang / ngag dang / sems kyis rtul ba med pa de lta bu yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos 'di ni gsal ba rnyog pa med pa yin pas/ de ni sems 59—303

rnyog pa can gyis mchod 17par mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na sems rtog pa can yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gzugs kyi mtshan ma rjes su dran pas sangs rgyas rjes su dran par byed pa'i sems ni sems rtog pa can yin no/ /sgra dang / skad dang / dbyangs dang /tshig gi lam gyis chos rjes su dran par byed pa'i sems ni sems rnyog pa can yin no / /'bras bu thob pa mngon du byed pas/ dge 'dun rjes su dran par byed pa'i sems ni sems rnyog pa can yin no/ /nyon mongs pa gtan spang5yib rjes su dran par byed pa'i sems ni sems rnyog pa can yin no/ /skye ba la rten pas lha rjes su dran par byed pa'i sems ni sems rtog pa can yin no/ /ma dul ba'i sbyin pa'i sems ni sems rnyog pa can yin no/ /ma zhi ba'i tshul khrims kyi sems ni sems rtog pa can yin no/ /sems can la brten pa'i bzod pa'i sems ni sems rnyog pa can yin no/ /spros pa dang bcas pa'i shes rab kyi sems ni sems rtog pa can yin no/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa la gnas pa'i byams pa'i sems ni sems rtog pa can yin no/ /sems la nges par ma bsamasam pa'i bsam gtan gyi sems ni sems rnyog pa can yin no/ /the tsom can gyi snying rje'i sems ni sems rnyog pa can yin no/ /mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam dang bral ba'i dga' ba'i sems ni sems rtog pa can yin no/ /gnyis 5la gnas pa'i btang snyoms kyi sems ni sems rnyog pa can yin no/ /lus su 'du shes pa'i tshor ba'i sems ni sems rtog pa can yin no/ /chos su 'du shes pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i sems ni sems rnyog pa can yin no/ /skye ba dang 'jig par 'du shes pa'i yang dag par 7sgong ba'i sems ni sems rtog pa can yin no//59—304

lus dang sems la rten pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i sems ni sems rnyog pa can yin no/ /dbang po drug la rten pa'i dbang po lnga'i sems ni sems rnyog pa can yin no/ /lta ba'i stobs dang ldan pa'i stobs lnga'i sems ni sems rnyog pa can yin no/ /chos su 'du shes pa la gnas pa'i byang chub kyi yan lag gi sems ni sems rnyog pa can yin no/ /'du byed yid la byed pa la brtson pa'i lam sgom 1pa'i sems ni sems rnyog pa can yin no/ /sdug bsngal la yongs su rtog na/pa'i 'du shes can gyi 5sems ni sems rnyog pa can yin no/ /kun 'byung ba la sgom pa'i 'du shes can gyi sems ni sems rnyog pa can yin no/ / 'gag par 5zad pas 'du shes pa'i sems ni sems rnyog pa can yin no/ /lam la sgom 7par 'du shes pa'i sems ni sems rtog pa can yin ten/ lha'i bu ji tsam du rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa nyid la sgro 'dogs par byed pa de tsam du sems rnyog pa can yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal sems rnyog pa med pa gang dag yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang dag sems nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dag go/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal nam mkha' la sems cung zad kyang yod dam/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu ji ltar nam mkha' la sems med pa bzhin du sems de yang de dang 'dra ste/ gang gi sems de 'dra ba de ni sems nam mkha' dang mnyam pa yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/'jam dpal gnas de la su zhig mos par 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/lha'i bu lhag par byed pa la brtson pa rnams kyis mos par dka' ba yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal lhag par byed pa zhes bya ba de 9ji lta bu yin/'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang sems nam mkha' dang mnyam pa nyid kyi 59—305

phyir lhag par byed pa'o/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ci zhig lhag par byed pa yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu rtag par byed pa ni lhag par byed pa yin no/ /mi rtag par 1)byed pa ni lhag par byed pa yin no/ /de bzhin du bde ba dang / sdug bsngal dang / sdug pa dang / mi sdug pa dang /bdag dang / bdag med par byed pa ni lhag par byed pa yin no/ /stong pa zhes bya ba dang / gang zag ces bya ba de ni lhag par byed pa yin no/ /mtshan ma med pa zhes bya ba dang / smon pa med pa zhes bya ba 'di tsho ni lhag par byed pa yin no/ /sgyu ma dang / rmi lam dang / mig yor dang / gzugs brnyan dang ske/ brag ca 5dang / chu zla dang / smig rgyu dang / sprul pa'i dpe nye bar dgod pa dag gi 4chos rnam par 'jog par byed/ mtshon par byed/ 'jug par byed/ ston par byed pa de ni lhag par byed pa yin no/ /de ji tsam du chos rnam par 'jog par byed pa de tsam du lhag par byed pa yin te/ kun nas nyon mongs pa la skyon du byed pa dang / rnam par byang ba la skyon med par byed pa de ni lhag par byed pa yin no/ /'khor ba la skyon du lta bar byed pa dang /mya ngan las 'das pa la phan yon du lta bar byed pa de ni lhag par byed pa yin te/lha'i bu de dag ni lhag pa'i nga rgyal can rnams kyis 5lhag par byed pa dag yin rnal/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na lhag pa'i nga rgyal med pa yin/'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gis nges par 'byung ba'i dbyings rtogs shing / nyon mongs pa thams cad 'gog pa bsgrubs 6te/ gnas kyang 'gog pa 'gog par yang mi byed la/ skye ba med pa skyed par yang mi byed cing /sgra thams cad kyis skrag par yang mi byed la/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rang 59—306

bzhin gang yin pa de nyid rnam par byang ba'i rang bzhin yin pa de ltar shes shing ske/ chos thams cad la gnyis dang bral ba dang / blang ba med pa dang /dor ba med pa thob pa de ni lha'i bu lhag pa'i nga rgyal med pa yin no/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas bstan pa 'di bshad pa na lha'i bu nyi khri nyis stong chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag go/ /dge slong lnga stong ni len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyi khri nyis stong gis mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /srog chags stong phrag rab tu mang po dag gis ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /dge bsnyen stong yang chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag go/ /khyim tsho1pa dang rab tu byung ba las bud med nyis stong yang chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag go/ /de nas lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis nyan thos chen po de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed cag kyang the tsom naci yod pa dag 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la dris shig /de nas gnas brtan 'od srung chen pos 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal dadage slong rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam gtan byed pa ji zhig la bsam gtan byed pa yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ btsun pa 'od srung chen po dge slong rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam gtan byed pa ni rtsa ba med pa dang / mtha' med pa dang /gnas med pa la bsam gtan byed pa dang / mi 'khrugs 4pa la bsam gtan byed pa dang / yang dag pa la bsam gtan byed pa yin no/ /'od srung chen 53—307

pos smras pa/ 'jam dpal ci las bsams te 1)de skad smra/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ btsun pa 'od srung chen po rtsa ba ni rang gi lus yin/ mtha' ni ngar 'dzin pa yin/ gnas ni khams gsum pa yin/ 'khrugs pa ni nyon mongs pa rnams yin/ mi mnyam pa ni gnyis yin te/ de la des lus ni rtsa ba med par shes/ ngar 'dzin pa ni mtha' med par shes/ khams gsum ni gnas med par shes/ nyon mongs pa rnams ni mi 'khrugs na par shes/ bsam gtan rnams ni gnyis su med par shes pas na/ btsun pa 'od srung chen po kho bos de las bsams rinas dge slong rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam gtan byed pa ni rtsa ba med pa dang / mtha' med pa dang / gnas med pa la bsam gtan byed pa dang / mi 'khrugs 4pa la bsam gtan byed pa dang / yang dag pa la bsam gtan byed pa yin rino zhes smras so/ / shā ri'i 'bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chags pa med pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa yin / 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ btsun pa shā 7ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' gang 8chags pa thams cad la spyod par byed kyang chags pa thams cad kyis gos par mi 'gyur zhing / nyon mongs pa thams cad la mngon sum du byed kyang sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ nyon mongs pa de dag gi rang bzhin gang yin pa'i nyon mongs pa de dag kyang spong bar mi byed na/ de tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' chags pa med pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa yin no/ /mod gal gyi bu chen pos smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che ba yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po byang chub sems dpa' gang 'dus byas kyang ma thob/ 'dus ma byas 59—308

kyang ma thobamanyul/ slob pa dang mi slob pa rnams kyang 'dul bar byed na/ de tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che ba yin no/ /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs pa med par gnas pa yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad sgrib pa med par shes par byed lan/ pha rol dang tshu ྅rol dang bral bar byed cing / byang chub kyi sgrib pa yang mi spong la ting nge 'dzin las kyang mi ldang zhing / bya ba thams cad kyang 4 ston par byed na/de tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs pa med par gnas pa yin no/ /byams ma'i 5bu gang pos smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos smra ba 6yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ btsun pa gang po gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' dbang po thams cad kyis spobs par byed cing / 'du byed thams cad mi rtag 7go zhes 'bras bu yod par chos ston par byed la/bskal pa stong phrag rnams su don dang / tshig dang / yi ge ston pa rnams kyis rgyas par ston par na byed kyang mthar thug par mi 'gyur na/ de tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' chos ston pa yin no/ /nam grus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bsam gtan pa yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa / btsun pa nam gru gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mnyam par gzhag 9pa nyid yin par yang shes par byed la/ sems rnam par g.yengs pa rnams la snying rje chen po bskyed de/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i bar du spyod par byed cing / bsam gtan la gnas pa las g.yo bar mi 'gyur na/ de tsam gyis na 1 byang chub sems dpa' bsam gtan pa yin no/ /59wa 309

nye bar 'khor gyis smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'dul ba 'dzin pa yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ btsun pa nye bar 'khor gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' chos rnams gtan dul ba nyid du yang shes par byed cing ltung ba dang nyon mongs pa dang bral la/ ltung ba dang nyon mongs pa gdul ba'i phyir chos ston par yangamanyu)byed cing / de ltar nyon mongs pas rnams rtogs par yang byed la byang chub kyang tshol bar byed na de tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' 'dul ba 'dzin pa yin no/ /ma 'gags dpas smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' lha'i mig dang ldan pa yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ btsun pa ma 'gagasas kyipa gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' phyogs bcu'i gzugs snang ba thams cad kyang mthong bar byed la/ gzugs dben par mthong bas chos thams cad dben par mthong ba rjes su 5)rtogs par byed na/ de tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' lha'i mig dang ldan pa yin no/ /ba 6ku las smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dbang po bsrung ba 7yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' yul thams cad sangs rgyas kyi yul yin par lta 8zhing / sangs rgyas kyi yul yang yul 9med par lta nyi na de tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' dbang po bsrung ba 11yin no12/ /sor mo'i phreng bas smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dbang po rno ba yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' byang chub rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa'i phyir/mtshams 12med pa dang mnyam par lta 1 bar byed na de tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' dbang po rno ba yin no/ / kā tyā'i 15bu chen pos smras pa/ 'jam 59—310

dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mdo sde rnam par 'byed pa la mkhas pa yin / 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ btsun pa kā kyā'i nyu)bu chen po gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' so so yang dag par rig pa mi zad pa bzhi thob cing /tshig gcig rinyagis kyang bskal pa 'bum gyi bar du rgya cher rnam par 'byed cing ston la/ ci nas kyang kun nas nyon mongs pa spong bar mi byed pa dang / rnam par byang ba len par mi byed pa de ltar ston par byed pa dang / chos nyid gnas pa las kyangs mi g.yo la gnas thams cad la yang mi rten pa de ltar ston par byed na / de tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' mdo sde rnam par 'byed pa la mkhas pa yin no/ /gsus po che chen pos smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' so so yang dag 4 rig pa thob pa yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' brjod du med pa'i don gyis don so so yang dag par rig pa ston pa dang / chos kyi dbyings gnas pa nyid kyis 5)chos so so yang dag par rig pa ston pa dang / ming dang mtshan ma med pa nyid kyis nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag par rig pa ston pa dang / brag cas dang mnyam pa nyid kyis spobs pa so so yang dag par 7rig pa' ston par byed na/ de tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa yin no/ /sgra gcan zin gyis smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ btsun pa sgra gcan zin gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs yang dag par blangs shing /sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ tshul khrims 'chal pa'i 'gro ba gang yin par 'gro bar byed na de tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims 53—311

dang ldan pa yin no/ /kun dga' bos smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar 1)na byang chub sems dpa' mang du thos pa yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ btsun pa kun dga' bo gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs par 2nyan par byed cing thos pa thams cad kyi don kyang rtogs par byed la / ji ltar thos pa yang 'dzin par byed cing / ji ltar gzungasngo snab bzhin ston par yang byed na de tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' mang du thos pa yin no/ /de nas lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis nyan thos chen po de dag la 'di skad lasmras so / /tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed cag 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad bstan pa de lta bu'i chos 'ga' dang ldan nam/ de dag gis smras pa/ lha'i bu bdag cag la ni chos de dag las 'ga' tsam yang med do/ /lha'i bus smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa dag de lta na khyed cag nyan thos chen po mchog tu gyur pa ma yin par mi 'gyur ram/ shā 5ri'i bus smras pa/ lha'i bu 'di lta ste dper na/gnag rjes las brten na rdzing bu mchog yin pa de bzhin du nyan thos gzhan dag las brten na kho bo cag kyang mchog yin no/ /'di lta ste dper na/ rgya mtsho chen po las brten na 'og gi chu'i phung po mchog yin pa de bzhin du nyan thos dang ske/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad las brten na byang chub sems dpa' mchog yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ btsun pa shā ri'i bus 6de ni nyan thos mngon pa'i nga rgyal med pa rnams kyis bstan pa yin te/ legs so legs so/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu de de bzhin te/ nyan thos ni lhag pa'i nga rgyal med pa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni lhag pa'i nga rgyal can yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji las bsams 7te de skad smra/ 'jam 59—312

dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu 'di ltar nyan thos rnams ni rangs1kyisangs rgyas la brten nas nga rgyal spangs pa yin gyi/ byang chub sems dpa' ni lhag pa'i nga rgyal can yin la/ nga rgyal des sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams yang dag par sgrub par byed pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' ni lhag pa'i nga rgyal can yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal lhag pa'i nang rgyal can ni bdag la stod 7par byed cing gzhan la smod par byed pa yin na/ byang chub sems dpa' yang de lta bur mi 'gyur ram/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu de bzhin te/ byang chub sems dpa' ni bdag la stodas par byed cing gzhan la smod par byed pa yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ci las bsams 5)te de skad smra / 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' ni rnam grangs du mar theg pa chen po'i bsngags pa rjodam par byed cing / nyan thos kyi theg pa pa'i bsngags pa ma yin par rjodamanapar byed pa dang / ji ltar sems can rnams byang chub tu sems skyed par 'gyur snyam nas bdag nyid kyi yon tan gyi chos rjod 9par byed cing / 'di la dga' ba'i sems skyed par mi sna 'gyur bar bya'o/ /snyam nas theg pa dman pa la rnam par sdang bar byed pa yin pas lha'i bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' ni theg pa chen po la stod 1par byed pa dang / nyan thos kyi theg pa la smod par byed pa yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/'jam dpal de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' ltung ba dang bcas par mi 'gyur ram / 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gis nanor bu mching bu'i bsngags pa ma yin par rjod 1 cing / nor bu rin po che bee drurya'i chibasngags pa brjod dpar gyur na de yang ltung ba dang bcas par 'gyur ram/ lha'i bus smras 59—313

pa / 'jam dpal de ni mi 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i 1theg pa chen po'i bsngags pa rjodadza par byed cing nyan thos kyi theg pa'i bsngags pa ma yin pa rjod 55)par byed pa yang ltung ba dang bcas par mi 'gyer ro/ /lha'i bu 'di lta ste dper na/ skyes bu shin tu stobs dang ldan pa gang zhig gis 'khor los sgyur caraba'i rgyal po'i bsngags pa rjod 5cing khams kyi rgyal po la de lta ma yin na6ri/ de smad pa'i 'os su 'gyur ba yin snyam mam / lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal de lta ma yin no/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' theg pa chen po la stod 8par byed cing nyan thos kyi theg pa la smod par byed pa yang smad pa'i 'os su mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ 'jam dpal legs so legs so/ /khyod kyi59tshig de ni legs par 1 smras te/ 'jam dpal theg pa chen po'i bsngags pa brjod pas ni theg pa thams cad kyi 11bsngags pa brjod par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jam dpal theg pa thams cad ni de las nges par byung ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' gang la brten nas byang chub tu sems skyed par byed don/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' ni sems can thams cad kyi 1 nyon mongs pa la brten nas byang chub tu sems skyed par byed do/ /lha'i bus smras pa / 'jam dpal ci'i phyir na byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa la brten nas byang chub tu sems skyed par byed/ 'jam dpal 59—314

gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gal te sems can rnams kyi 6)nyon mongs pa dag byang chub kyi theg pa ma yin du zin na ni byang chub sems dpa' yang byang chub tu sems bskyed nas go char gyon par mi 'gyur ro/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal byang sa chub kyi sems ci zhig la rten/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la rten to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lha'i bu sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad ni byang chub kyi sems kyi rtsa ba la brten nas skye bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal chos thams cad 4ci la rten/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu chos thams cad ni rtsa ba med pa'i gnas la rten pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lha'i bu chos thams cad ni mtha' yas pa'i phyir rtsa ba med pa dang / mngon par skabs yod pa dang / nam mkha' la rten pa yang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lha'i bus smras pa / 'jam dpal sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ji snyed yod/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu chos thams cad ji snyed pa de snyed yod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / de bzhin gshegs pas ni chos thams cad sangs rgyas pas na/ lha'i bu de'i phyir chos thams cad ji snyed pa sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyang de snyed do/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal 'o na ci 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang /gti mug rnams kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos yin nam/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/lha'i bu de de bzhin te/ 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug rnams kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nyon mongs pa de dag gi rtsa ba'i gnas rjes su rtogs pa ni sangs rgyas yin no zhes ston pa'i phyir ro/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal gang gis sems can thams cad sangs rgyas su 59—315

'gyur ba'i rnam grangs yod dam/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu rnam grangs med pas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas su 'gyur gyis 3)rnam grangs kyis ni ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pas ni sems can thams cad rtogs par thugs su chud pa'i phyir ro/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar rtogs par thugs su chud/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu sems can med pa'i rnam pa dang stong pa nyid kyis na rnam pas so/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal stong pa nyid kyis ci zhig rtogs par byed/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gal te cung zad rjes su rtogs par byed na ni de stong pa nyid du mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lha'i bu stong pa nyid ni rnam par rtog pa med pa dang rtsol ba med pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lha'i bus smras pa/'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pas stong pa nyid rjes su rtogs pa ni byang chub yin no zhes ma gsungs sam/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu stong pa nyid gang yin pa de nyid byang chub yin pas na bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang stong pa nyid rjes su rtogs pa kho na byang chub yin no zhes gsungs so/ /lha'i bus smras pa/'jam dpal stong pa nyid la gnas pa ji /zhig la gnas pa yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu stong pa nyid la gnas pa ni ca'adod pa dang / gzugs dang ske/ gzugs med pa la gnas pa ma yin/ phung po dang / khams dang /skye mched la gnas pa ma yin/ lus dang sems la gnas pa ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lha'i bu de riganas pa gang gis gnas par 'gyur ba'i gnas pa de yang stong pas na/ stong pa nyid ni stong pa nyid la mi gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa don dam pa stong pa nyid 59wa 316

kyi gnas pas gnas par mi mdzad dam/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa nyid stong pa nyid yin la/ stong pa nyid gang yin pa de ni gnyis su med pa yin pas na/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni gnyis su med pa'i gnas pas 1gnas par mdzad do/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal gnyis su med pa'i naganas pa gang 3yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gnyis su med pa'i gnas pa ni gnyis su med pa nyid yin gyi/ de la gnas pa gzhan med de/ de'i gnas pa gnyis su med pa las cagazhan med pa de nyid kyang gnyis su med pa nyid yin nor/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal gnyis zhes nebya ba ni gang / gnyis su med pa zhes bya ba ni gang / 'jam dpal gyis smras pa / lha'i bu 'dod chags dang / 'dod chags dang bral bar byed pa de ni gnyis so/ /'dod chags kyi rang bzhin ni gnyis su med pa'o/ /zhe sdang dang /zhe sdang med par byed pa de ni gnyis so/ /zhe sdang gi 7rang bzhin ni gnyis su med pa'o/ /gti mug dang / gti mug med par byed pa de ni gnyis so/ /gti mug gi rang bzhin ni gnyis su med pa'o/ / nyon mongs pa dang /sgyus/ nyon mongs pa med par byed pa de ni gnyis so/ /nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhin ni gnyis su med pa'o/ /bdag dang bdag med par byed pa 9de ni gnyis so/ /bdag gi rang bzhin ni gnyis su med pa'o/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal bdag gi rang bzhin gang yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu bdag gi rang bzhin ni gzod ma nas dag pa'i phyir bdag med pa nyid yin no/ /bdag gi rang bzhin ni gzod ma nas dag pa'i phyir gzod ma nas dben pa nyid dang glu/ gzod ma nas ma skyes pa nyid dang / gzod ma nas ma byung ba nyid yin 59—317

rnam/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ci'i phyir rang bzhin zhes bya/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu de ni 'gyur ba med pas de'i phyir rang bzhin zhes bya'o / /de ni gzod ma nyid nas gsal zhing nyon mongs pa can ma yin pas de'i phyir rang bzhin zhes bya'o/ /de ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa nyid kyis mnyam zhing tshad med pas de'i phyir rang bzhin zhes bya'o/ /de ni spros pa dang bral ba dang ske/ de ni rgyu ba tshodang bral ba dang / de ni 'od gsal bas de'i phyir rang bzhin zhes bya'o/ /de ni blang ba med pa dang dor ba med pas de'i na phyir rang bzhin zhes bya'o/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal rang bzhin mi shes pa dag gang yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang dag chos rnams kyi rang bzhin mi shes pa dag go/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal rang bzhin shes pa dag gang yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang dag de dag gi rang bzhin shes pa dag go/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal dad pa dang ldan pa'i mtshan nyid gang yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu dad pa dang ldan pa'i mtshan nyid ni chags pa thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal dge slong dad pa dang mi ldan pa ji ltar dad pas byin pa la dad par byed/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu dad pa dang mi ldan pa zhes bya ba ni gang mngon sum du gyur pa'i chos thams cad la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog cing / gzhan gyi dad pas yang dang yang du mi 'gro ba yin pas de'i phyir dad pa dang mi ldan pa zhes bya ste/ de ni dad pas byin pa spyod par mi byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzod ma nas dag pa'i phyir rol/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal dge slong gang / dge 'dun dang lhan 59—318

cig mi gnas pa de la ji 6)skad ces bya/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu dge slong gang dge 'dun dang lhan cig mi gnas pa de ni des na 'jig rten gyi sbyin gnas su 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lha'i bu dge 'dun ni 'dus ma byas pa yin la/ byang chub sems dpa'am pani 'dus ma byas dang lhan cig mi gnas pas de'i phyir de ni 'jig rten gyi sbyin gnas su 'gyur ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal gal te byang chub sems dpa' 'dus ma byas dang lhan cig gnas par gyur na nyes pa cir 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu 'dus ma byas thob nas sems can rnams skyob par mi byed cing nyan thos su 'gyur bas de'i nyes pa ni der 'gyur ro/ /lha'i bus smras pa/'jam dpal 'dus byas ni so so /skye bo'i sa yin la/ 'dus ma byas ni 'phags pa rnams kyi sa yin na/ 'o na ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i sa spangs shing / so so riskye bo'i sa la gnas pa 'jig rten gyi sbyin gnas su 'gyur / 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' 'dus byas la yang mi gnas/ 'dus ma byas la yang mi gnas pas de'i phyir de ni 'jig rten gyi sbyin gnas su 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' ni 'du byed las yid bskyod pa dang / 'dus ma byas la mi gnas pa yin pas 'dus byas kyi skyon dang bral ba dang / 'dus ma 5)byas shes pa rtogs pa yin te/ de 'dus byas kyi skyon dang bral bas ni 'dus byas la mi gnas la/'dus ma byas shes pa rtogs pas ni 'dus ma byas su mi ltung 6ba'i phyir ro/ /lha'i bu 'di lta ste dper na/ tshan po che chen pos steng gi bar snang la mda' 'phangs par gyur la/ de nas mda' de nam mkha' la mi gnas par 'dug cing 59—319

sa la yang mi ltung na/ lha'i bu de la dka' ba cung ༄1zad yod dam/ lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal dka'o/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu de bas kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag 'dus byas kyang mi spong zhing / 'dus ma byas kyang thob par byed la/ 'dus ma byas su yang mi ltung zhing / 'dus byas thob pa rnams kyang yongs su smin par byed pa ni ches dka' ba yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig pa 'dus byas sam/ 'on te 'dus ma byas sam/ gang las 'byung bar 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig pa ni 'dus byas las kyang 'byung bar 'gyur/ 'dus ma byas las kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lha'i bu 'dus byas las ni nyon mongs pa'i 'jig pa 'byung la/ 'dus ma byas las ni nyon mongs pa med pa'i 'jig pa 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal nyon mongs pa med pas 'jig pa ci yod/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu khams gsum na ni nyon mongs pa'i 'jig pa yod la/ byang chub sems dpa' gang khams gsum du nyon mongs par mi byed na/ de ni nyan thos su 'gyur ro/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'jig pa med pa yin/'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' gang shes rab kyi shes pas 'dus byas la spyod par byed cing / thabs kyi shes pas 'dus ma byas su mi ltung ba de lta na/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' na'ajig pa med pa yin no/ /lha'i bu gzhan yang gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems can la lta bas 'dus byas spong bar mi byed cing / sangs rgyas kyi chos la lta bas 'dus ma byas su mi 59—320

ltung ba de lta 1)na/ lha'i bumatshon)byang chub sems dpa' 'jig pa med pa yin no/ /lha'i bu gzhan yang gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams kyi tshogs nye bar bsagasam pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas la sbyor bar byed cing / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi tshogs nye bar bsagasam pa'i phyir/ 'dus ma byas su mi ltung ba de lta na / byang chub sems dpa' 'jig pa med pa yin no/ /lha'i bu gzhan yang gang gi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' 'dus ma byas la gnas te/ bsam gtan rnams skyed par byed cing / thabs la gnas te bsam gtan rnams las ldog par byed pa de lta na/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig pa med pa yin no/ /lha'i bu gzhan yang gang gi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi sems la gnas te dge ba'i rtsa rab nye bar sogs 6par byed cing / snying rje chen po la gnas te sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed pa de lta na/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig pa med pa yin no/ /lha'i bu gzhan yang gang gi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' dben pa la gnas te bdud kyi las rnams rtogs par byed cing ske/ thabs la gnas te bdud kyi las rnams spong bar byed pa de lta 7na/byang chub sems dpa' 'jig pa med pa yin no/ /lha'i bu gzhan yang gang gi tshe / byang chub sems dpa' byams pa chen po la gnas te chos ston par byed cing ske/ snying rje chen po la gnas te/ zang zing gi sbyin pa sbyin par byed pa de lta 8na/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig pa med pa yin no/ /lha'i bu gzhan yang gang gi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba la gnas te/ mya ngan las 'das pa yongs su spyad pa'i 9las byed cing / mya ngan las 'das pa la gnas te / 'khor ba yongs su spyad pa'i 0las byed pa de tsam gyis na/ byang chub 59—321

sems dpa' 'jig pa med pa yin no/ /lha'i bu gzhan yang gang gi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' skye ba med pas skye bar byed cing / 'pho ba med pas 'byung bar byed pa dang / chos la lta bas snang bar byed cing / phung po dang /khams dang / skye mched kyis 1rab tu phye ba ma yin pa dang / thams cad dang rjes su 'brel zhing zhi ba dang / nye bar zhi bar gyur pa dang / 'bar bar byed cing ske/ 'bar bas tshig par mi byed pa dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad la yongs su sbyong bar nabyed cing / nyon mongs pa'i skyon rnams kyis mi gos pa dang ske/ slob pa dang / mi slob pa rnams 'dul bar byed cing / nyan thos kyi rnam par grol ba la reg par mi byed pa dang / sems can rnams kyi bsam pa la 'jug cing / chos kyi bsam pa spong bar mi byed pa dang / bdud kyi lcags kyu shes par byed cing / chos kyi lcags kyu spong bar mi byed pa dang / shes pas 'jug 4par byed cing / thabs kyis ldog par byed pa dang / 'phags pa'i rnam pa ston par byed cing / 'phags pa ma yin pa yongs su smin par bya ba la spro bar byed pa dang / sangs rgyas mthong ba la mngon par dga' bar byed cing /chos mthong ba la kun tu 'dod par byed pa de tsam gyis nar/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig pa med pa yin no/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas bstan pa 'di bshad pa na/ lha'i bu lnga khri chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag go/ /lha'i bu nyi khri lnga stong ni len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa lnga khri ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyi khri ni spobs pa thogs pa med pa skyes so/ /lha dang mi 59—322

rnams 0)kyi skye dgu las 'o srog chags stong phrag rab tu mang po dag gis ni byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la lha'i mchod pa dag byas so/ /gzhan yang lha'i bubyungab rtsal sems kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' lam la gnas pa yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa / lha'i bu gang gi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' 'dod chags spang ba'i phyir yang chos ston par byed la/ 'dod chags dang bral ba mngon du yang mi byed pa dang ske/ zhe snang spang ba'i 5phyir yang chos ston par byed la/ zhe sdang spong ba mngon du yangs nimi byed pa dang / gti mug spang ba'i 5)phyir yang chos ston par byed la/ gti mug spong 46 ba mngon du yang mi byed pa dang / nyon mongs pa spang ba'i 7phyir chos ston par yang byed la/ nyon mongs pa spong ba mngon du yang mi byed pa de 8)tsam gyis na59/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' lam la gnas pa yin no/ /lha'i bu gzhan yang gang gi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems can rnams la stong pa nyid ston par yang byed la/ stong pa nyid mngon du yang mi byed pa dang / sems can rnams la mtshan ma med pa ston par yang byed la / mtshan ma med pa mngon du yang mi byed pa dang / sems can rnams la smon pa med pa ston par yang byed la/ smon pa med pa mngon du yang mi byed pa dang ske/ de bzhin du sems can rnams la mngon par 'du byed pa med pa dang /skye ba med pa dang / 'byung ba med pa dang / dngos po med pa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba dang mi ldan pa dang / 'gog pa'i chos ston par yang byed la/'gog pa mngon du yang mi byed pa de tsam gyis na/ byang chub sems dpa' lam 59wa 323

la gnas pa yin no/ /lha'i bu gzhan yang gang gi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' yongs su mi gtong bas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 1sgrub par byed pa dang /tshul khrims las yang dag par 'da' bas/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub par byed pa dang / gnod sems kyis bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub par byed pa dang / le los brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub par byed pa dang ske/ brjid ngas 2pas bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub par byed pa dang ske/ bems po dang / lug ltar lkugs 5pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub par byed pa de tsam gyis na/ byang chub sems dpa' lam la gnas pa yin rnam/ /lha'i bus smras capa/ 'jam dpal ji 5las bsamasam te de skad smra/'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 7yongs su mi gtong ba yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sems can yongs su mi gtong ba dang / chos yongs su mi gtong ba dang / byang chub kyi sems yongs su mi gtong ba dang / dge ba'i chos thams cad yongs su mi gtong ba ste/ byang chub sems dpa' ni chos bzhi po 8de dag yongs su mi gtong bas/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub par byed do/ /lha'i bu tshul khrims las yang dag par 'da' ba zhes bya ba de ni de'i rang bzhin ma yin pa'i tshig bla dgas te/ tshul khrims las yang dag par 'da' bas ting nge 'dzin dang ske/ ting nge 'dzin las yang dag par 'da' bas shes rab dang / shes rab las yang dag par 'da' bas/ rnam par grol ba shes pa sgrub par byed de/lha'i bu khyod kyis rnam grangs des/ gang tshul khrims las yang dag par 'da' ba de / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub par byed pa yin par rig par bya'o/ /59—324

lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' gang gnod sems la zhugs pa ni/ nyan thos kyi theg pa las log par zhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa las log par zhugs pa 17yin pas/ de ni theg pa chen po la legs par zhugs pa yin te(5rka/ gang theg pa chen po la legs par zhugs pa de ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub par byed pa —yin no/ /lha'i bu gang gi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' lus kyis44 rtul bar mi byed cing / ngag dang / sems kyis partul bar mi byed pa de ni le lo can yin la/ gang de ltar chos la mngon par brtson pa de ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub par byed pa yin no/ /lha'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' ni/ rmi lam na yang sa gnyis po dag la dga' ba'i sems skyed par mi byed pas/ de ni brjid ngas 6pa yin la/gang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la brjed ngas 7pa de ni/theg pa chen po la mnyam par bzhag na pa yin pas/ de ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub par byed pa yin no/ /lha'i bu chos thams cad ni bems po ste / rtswa dang / shing dang / rtsig 9pa dang / lam dang / mig yor dang /lug ltar lkugs 1 pa dang 'dra bar/ rang bzhin gyis nus pa med pa yin pas/gang gi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' shes rab dang / ye 11shes kyis de ltar chos thams cad bems po dang / lug ltar lkugs 2pa lta bus byang chub sgrub par byed pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub par byed pa yin te/ de ltar zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni lam sgrub par byed pa yin no/ /lha'i bu gzhan yang gang gi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba'i lam yang mi spong la / mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam yang tshol bar byed pa dang / lam gyi las kyi 59wa 325

rgyun yang mi gcod cing / lam gyi bya ba yang sgrub par byed pa dang / lam ngan par zhugs pa'i sems can rnams nya kyang lam la 'god par byed pa de lta na/byang chub sems dpa' lam la gnas pa yin no(lde/ /lha'i bu gzhan yang gang gi tshe / byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad dang / chos thams cad btsal yang mi rnyed pa dang / byang chub kyi lam spong bar mi byed pa dang /'bras bu yod pa shebasam gtan byed pa de lta na/ byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi lam thob pa yin no/ /lha'i bu gzhan yang gang gi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos kyi lam yang rab tu shes la/ nyan thos kyi lam gyis nges par 'byung bar yang mi byed pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi lam yang rab tu shes la/rang sangs rgyas kyi lam gyis nges par 'byung bar mi byed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam yang thob par byed la lam des kyang dbang po yongs su ma rdzogs par nges par 'byung bar mi byed pa de lta na/ byang chub sems dpa' lam la gnas pa yin no/ /lha'i bu gzhan yang gang gi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad mngon par 'du byed pa dang / mngon par 'du bya ba'i 'bras bu don du mi gnyer ba dang / mngon par 'du byed pa'i skyon gyis mi gos pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa bsgo mngon par 'du bya ba thams cad byang chub tu yongs su sngo 5bar byed pa dang / byang chub kyi phyir 'phel ba yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba dang / 'bri ba yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba de lta na / byang chub sems dpa' lam la gnas pa yin no/ /lha'i bu gzhan yang gang gi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' lam ngan pa las lam yongs su tshol bar byed pa dang / lam yongs su btsal nas kyang nges par 'byung bar mi byed pa de 53—326

lta na/ byang chub sems dpa' lam la gnas pa yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' lam ngan pa las lam yongs su tshol bar byed/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu lam ngan pa zhes bya ba ni 'khor ba ste/ byang chub sems dpa' ni de la gnas nas/ sems can nges par 'byung ba'i phyir lam yongs su tshol bar byed kyi/ bdag nyid nges par 'byung ba'i phyir ni ma yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa ni 'jig rten thams cad dang mi 'thun pa yin no/— /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni 'jig rten na spyod kyang / 'jig rten gyi 1chos rnams kyis mi gos pa dang /nyon mongs pa med pa ston par byed kyang / nyon mongs pa med pa nyid du mi ltung ba dang / rga ba dang / 'chi ba ston par byed kyang / chos thams cad skye ba med pa dang 'byung ba med par shes shing / skyon med pa mngon du mi byed pa dang ske/ phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched la yongs su spyod par ri byed kyang ske/ phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched don du mi gnyer ba dang /phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir/sems can rnams la chos ston kyang / yongs su shes pa de dag yongs su shes par mi byed pa dang / bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms dpar 'jug pa dang / mngon par sgrub par byed cing /sems rnam par g.yengs pa rnams nye bar 'jog par byed kyang / nye bar 'jog pa la 'byung bar mi byed pa dang / bdud kyi yul nye bar ston par byed kyang /bdud kyi las rnams kyis mi 'phrogs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi yul spong bar mi 59wa 327

byed pa dang / bdud kyi yul gyi rjes su mi 'jug pa dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi yul las ldog par mi byed pa dang / sems can gyi khams kyi yul nye bar len par byed pas na/ de'i phyir sems can chen po de dag gi spyod pa ni 'jig rten thams cad dang mi 'thun pa yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal khyod byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa la spobs par gyis shig /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu bsam pa yongs su dag cing / nang dang / phyi rol dben pa nyid kyis lhag pa'i bsam pa la spyod pa dang / rab tu spyod pa med pa nyid kyis sbyor ba la spyod pa dang / sems mi brjid pa nyid kyis byang chub kyi sems mi brjed 1pa la spyod pa dang / sems dul ba nyid kyis sbyin pa la spyod pa dang ske/ sems zhi ba nyid kyis tshul khrims la spyod pa dang / rmas ( pa med pa nyid kyis bzod pa la spyod pa dang / lus dang sems 5dben pa nyid kyis brtson 'grus la spyod pa dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par g.yeng ba med pa nyid kyis bsam gtan la spyod pa dang / spros pa med pa nyid kyis shes rab la spyod pa dang ske/ sems can la bdag med pa nyid kyis byams pa la spyod pa dang / nyon mongs pa yod pa ma yin par rab tu zhi ba nyid kyis snying rje la spyod pa dang /rang bzhin gyis rnam par grol ba'i phyir dga' ba la spyod pa dang / mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i phyir btang snyoms la spyod pa dang / gzod ma nas ma skyes pa'i phyir mi rtag pa la so sor rtog pa la spyod pa dang / yongs su rtog pa sdug bsngal ba'i phyir sdug bsngal la so sor rtog pa la spyod pa dang / phyin ci log rang bzhin med pa'i phyir bdag med pa la so sor rtog pa la spyod pa dang / 'du shes yongs su shes pa'i phyir zhi ba la so sor rtog pa la spyod pa dang / phung po sgyu 59—328

ma lta bur yongs su shes pa'i phyir sdug bsngal yongs su shes pa la spyod pa dang /ma rig pa sngon du 'gro ba'i phyir kun 'byung ba shes pa la spyod pa dang / rang7cibazhin gyis 'gags midapa'i phyir 'gogs pa shes pa la spyod pa dang / 'dus byas la mngon par zhen pa med pa'i phyir lam shes pa la spyod pa dang / 'bras bu yongs su shes pa nyid kyis rgyu shes pa la spyod pa dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i phyir rkyen shes pa la spyod pa dang / du ma'i phyir tshogs pa la spyod pa dang ske/ brjod du med pa'i phyir don so so cayang dag par rig pa la spyod pa dang ske/ chos kyi dbyings dbyer med pa'i phyir chos so so yang dag par rig pa la spyod pa dang / ming dang gzugs 'byung ba med pa'i phyir nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag par rig pa la spyod pa dang / sgra 5brag ca46)dang mtshungs pa'i phyir spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa la spyod pa dang / tshig 'bru gsal ba nyid kyis don la rton 7pa la spyod pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i spyod yul ma spangs pa nyid kyis ye 8)shes la rton 9pa la spyod pa dang / las kyi rnam par smin pa stong pa 1 nyid kyis nges pa'i don gyi mdo sde la rton 11pa la spyod pa dang / gang zag yongs su smin par bya ba nyid kyis chos la rton 2pa la spyod pa dang / las rnam par dag pa'i phyir lha'i mig la spyod pa dang / tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i phyir lha'i rna ba la spyod pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rnam par dag pa'i phyir pha rol gyi sems shes pa la spyod pa dang / dus gsum mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa shes pa la spyod pa dang / sems la dbang sgyur 1 ba'i phyir rdzu 'phrul mngon par bsgrub pa la spyod pa dang / mi phyed pa'i phyir spyod pa brtan pa la spyod pa dang / mi lhod pa'i phyir spyod pa sra ba la spyod pa dang / bskyod du 59—329

med pa'i phyir gnas pa 1med pa la spyod pa dang / tha dad pa52)med pa nyid kyis spyod pa mnyam pa la spyod pa dang / thams cad rjes su ma brtags pa'i phyir sa dang —/ chu dang / me dang / rlung dang / nam mkha'am4)lta bur spyod pa dang / rnam par bsgrub pa'i mtshan nyid kyi phyir sgyu ma lta bu la spyod pa dang / yang dag pa ma yin pa'i mtshan nyid kyis rmi lam lta bu la spyod pa dang / rnam par rmongs pa'i mtshan nyid kyis smig rgyu ra lta bu la spyod pa dang / bdag mi sbed 6pa'i mtshan nyid kyis stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / sems rang bzhin med pa'i mtshan nyid kyis mtshan ma med pa la spyod pa dang / khams gsum rang bzhin med pa'i mtshan nyid kyis smon pa med pa la spyod pa dang / 'dus byas rang bzhin med pa'i mtshan nyid kyis mngon par 'du byed pa med pa la spyod pa dang /sems dang yid dang rnam par shes pa 'jug pa med pa'i mtshan nyid kyis bdud tshar bcad cipa la spyod pa dang / spyod pa thams cad rnam par bsgrub pa'i mtshan nyid kyis dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyun 8mi gcod pa la spyod pa ste/lha'i bu de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa la spyod pa yin no// //bam po gsum pa ste tha ma / lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa de ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa yin no/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu de de bzhin te / lha'i bu kho bo ni byang chub sems dpa' gang dad pas rjes su 'brang ba ma yin pa dang / chos kyi 1 rjes su 'brang ba ma yin pa dang / gang brgyad pa ma yin pa dang / rgyun du zhugs pa ma yin pa dang / lan cig 11phyir 'ong ba ma 59wa 330

yin pa dang / phyir mi 'ong ba ma yin pa dang / dgra bcom pa ma yin pa dang /gang nyan thos ma yin pa dang / rang sangs rgyas ma yin pa dang / gang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ma yin pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa ma yin pa dang /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma yin pa dang / ston pamanyam yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' yin par mi smra'o/ /lha'i bu kho bo ni byang chub sems dpa' gang so som skye bo'i chos can ma yin pa dang / 'dod chags kyi chos can ma yin pa dang / zhe sdang gi chos can ma yin pa dang / gti mug gi chos can ma yin pa dang / gang 'khor ba'i chos can ma yin pa dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i /chos can ma yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' yin par mi smra'o / /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji las bsams te byu )de skad smra/'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dad pas rjes su 'brang ba dang /chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / brgyad pa dang / rgyun du zhugs pa dang /lan cigs5)phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa dang /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang /de bzhin gshegs pa dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / ston pa dang / so so 6skye bo'i chos can dang / 'dod chags kyi chos can dang /zhe snang gi chos can dang / gti mug gi chos can dang / 'khor ba'i chos can dang ske/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i chos can yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la dad par byed pa dang / chags pa thams cad la dad par byed kyang de las chags par mi 'gyur ba dang / gzhan gyi dad pas mi 'gro ba dang / pha 59—331

rol tu phyin pa drug gi lam la dad pa skyed cing 'dzin par byed pa dang /chags pas chags par gyur pa rnams thar bar byed pa dang / chags pa med pa'i ye shes yongs su tshol bar byed pa dang / 'khor ba la chags par mi byed pa dang ske/ mya ngan las 'das par mi ltung ba de tsam gyis nam1)lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' dad pas rjes su 'brang ba yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs pa 'dzin par byed pa dang / kun 'dzin par byed pa dang /chos kyi zas dang ldan zhing zang zing gi nazas med pa dang / chos la gnas kyi nyon mongs pa la mi gnas pa dang / chos kyi stobs can yin gyi nga rgyal gyi stobs can ma yin pa dang / chos smra ba yin gyi 'jig rten rgyang pan pa'i gtam smra ba ma yin pa dang / chos kyi dbang phyug yin gyi nyon mongs pa'i dbang phyug ma yin pa dang / chos la rton pa 4yin gyi gang zag la rton 5pa ma yin pa dang / chos smra ba yin gyi chos ma yin par 6mi smra ba dang / chos kyi rjes su 'thun pa'i chos la rton 7pa yin gyi brtson pa btang ba'i chos la mi gnas pa dang / chos skyon med pa nyid du chos thams cad shes par byed pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo chags pa med pa dang ldan pa dang / nor bdun 8dang ldan pa dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin par byed pa dang / chos kyi khyad par la gnas pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' brgyad pa yin/'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' log pa 59—332

nyid brgyad las yang dag par 'das pa dang / yang dag pa nyid brgyad la rab tu gnas pa dang / lam yan lag brgyad pa rnam par sbyang ba la mkhas pa dang /sbyor ba yongs su ma rdzogs par lam des 1nges par 'byung bar mi byed pa dang /mi khom pa brgyad du skyes pa'i sems can rnams dal ba phun sum tshogs pa dag la 'god par byed pa dang / skyes bu dam pa'i rnam par rtogs tshon pa brgyad la gnas pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam gtan byed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa mi spong ba de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' brgyad pa yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rgyun du zhugs pa yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems can rgyun phyogs su dad ripa rnams rgyun las zlog par byed pa dang / 'khor ba'i rgyun thams cad kyang gcod par byed la 'khor ba mi gcod pa dang / ngan song thams cad rgyun gcod par byed pa dang —/ sems can rnams bde 'gro dang mya ngan las 'das pa mngon du bya ba'i lam la 'god par byed pa dang / mtshams bcad pa dang / lha dang mi la gzhol ba dang / bden pa ston par byed pa dang / rlom sems su mi ltung ba dang ske/ the tsom dang bral ba dang / nges pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos la gzhol ba dang / so so 5skye bo'i lam las yang dag par 'das pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi lam la rab tu tshiganas pa dang / 'khor ba'i gting rnyed pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa la mngon du phyogs par gyur pa dang / 'jig rten gyi sbyin gnas su gyur pa dang / 'dus byas la snang ba dang / 'dus ma byas pas rab tu phye ba dang / phyir ldog 7par mi 'gyur ba dang / dge 'dun 59wa 333

la yang dag par gzhol ba de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' rgyun du zhugs pa yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' lan cig 1phyir 'ong ba yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad 'ong ba med pa dang 'gro ba ri med par shes nas sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir bsam ( bzhin du 'ong ba dang / sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed pa dang / 'ong ba dang /'gro bar 4ston par byed pa dang / chos nyid la 'ong ba dang 'gro ba med par mthong ba dang / 'ong 5yang nyon mongs pa med pas 'ong ba dang / rang gi las yongs su dag pas 'gro ba dang / 'ong ba mnyam pa nyid mi spong ba dang /bdud kyi dbang gis mi 'gro ba dang / byang chub kyi lam nye bar ston pa'i phyir 'ong ba dang / nye bar blangs pa'i sems can bsgral ba'i phyir 'ong ba dang /byang chub kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa sra zhing mi phyed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' lan cig 6phyir 'ong ba yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi 'ong ba yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' lta ba rnams dang / phyin ci log rnams dang ske/ sgrib pa rnams su yang mi 'ong ba dang / 'dun pa dang / 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / 'jigs pa dang / gti mug gis yang 7kyi'ong ba dang —/ 'gro bar mi 'gyur ba dang / byas pa nanges par ma gyur cing 9kyisangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ma rdzogs par mi 1 'ong ba dang / 'ong ba med pa dang /'pho ba med pa la mkhas pa dang / rga shi med pa la thob pa dang / mthar nyanyaganas pa dang / byas pa nges 12pa dang / lung bstan pa thob pa dang /59—334

dmigs su med pa dang / rnam pa med pa thob pa dang / shes pas gzhan la rag ma las pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi 'ong ba yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom pa yin / 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' chags pa med cing 'dod chags gdul ba'i phyir sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / sdang07ba med cing zhe sdang gdul ba'i phyir sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / rmongs pa med cing gti mug gdul ba'i phyir sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / chos thams cad la nyon mongs pa med par gnas pa dang /sems can thams cad la sems ma btang ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la brtson 'grus brtsams pa dang / 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la dga' ba med pas dga' ba dang / dgra bcom pa dang pad ma bzhin du nyon mongs pa thams cad kyis ma gos pa dang / shes pas 'phags pa dang mnyam pa dang ske/ thabs kyis 'phags pa ma yin par gnas pa dang / nye bar len pa thams cad la bdag gir 5)med cing yongs su 'dzin pa med pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la bdag gir byed cing yongs su 'dzin pa dang / rang gi sems kyi rgyud dag la zag pa med pa'i sems dang ldan pa dang / gzhan gyi sems kyi rgyud dag la zag pa med par riganas par byed pa dang / sngon dam bcas pa dag la brnag pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang / tshum rol dang pha rol la gnas pa rnams kyi pha rol tu son pa dang / tshu 5rol gyi gnas ma spangs pa dang ske/ gzhan gyis sems can gzhan thar bar byed pa de lta na 6lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom pa yin no/ /lha'i 7bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal 53—335

ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad la ma thos pa'i chos sgrogs par byed cing yul rnams la spyod par mi byed pa dang / yang dag pa'i dam pa'i chos dang / skye ba med pa dang / 'gag pa med pa'i chos sgrogs par byed pa dang / rgyu dang / rkyen dang / bdag med pa dang / sems can med pa dang / rang bzhin gyis g.yo ba med paras1)sgrogs par byed pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos tshad med pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i chos rnams sgrogs par byed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang / ye shes chen po la chos thams cad rgyus nye bar 'gro bar rtsoms shig ces sgrogs par byed pa dang /sgrogs pa yang gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa dang / thos pas kyang rlom sems mi byed pa dang / sgrogs pa thams cad kyi sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' mi chad napa yongs su shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa mi zad pa thob pa dang /don dang tshig dang yig 'bru mi zad pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi sems dang ske/ spyod pa dang / shes par ston par byed pa dang / so so ci rigs byupar chos ston par byed pa dang / zhi ba'i sa la gnas pa dang / spros pa med pa dang / sngon gyi smon lam gyi paspyod pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rang sangs rgyas yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad rkyen la rag las pa dang / sems can med pa dang / srog med pa dang / gang zag med pa dang / bdag po med pa dang / rnam par bsgrub pa nye bar 6gnas pa'i mtshan nyid du shes pa 59—336

dang ske/ des rkyen rnams legs par mthong ba'i phyir byang chub 'dren par byed pa'i rkyen 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyi phyogs dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams kyi phyogs dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i phyogs dang /tshad med pa bzhi'i phyogs dang / mngon par shes pa'i phyogs yang dag par sgrub par byed pa dang / de rkyen nye bar sgrub par byed cing (1gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pas byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byed pa dang / sa ngan pa dag las sems skyo bar byed pa dang / nyi dkyitshe ba'i shes pa 'dul ba la mkhas pa dang / theg pa chen po la legs par rab tu gnas pa dang / chos thams cad la mngon du gyur pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' rang sangs rgyas yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad gzod ma nas dben pa nyid du rtogs par byed pa dang / sems can thams cad gzod ma nas bdag med pa nyid du rtogs dpar byed pa dang / ming mngon capar rtogs par bya ba'i phyir spyod pa dman pa dang / mchog dang / bar ma thams cad rtogs par byed pa dang /rang gi nyon mongs pa stong pa nyid kyis nyon mongs pa thams cad rtogs par byed pa dang / skad cig gcig la rjes su rtogs pa'i rim gyi 5sa dang spyod pa sna tshogs ston par byed pa dang / sems can gyi dbang po dang / mos pas chos ston par byed pa dang / 'bras bu yod par chos ston par byed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa yin/ 'jam 59—337

dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i lam du 'gro ba dang / de bzhin nyid mi brjid0pa dang / de bzhin nyid la rab tu gnas pa dang / de bzhin nyid kyi sbyin pa dang / de bzhin nyid kyi tshul khrims dang / de bzhin nyid kyi bzod pa dang / de bzhin nyid kyi brtson 'grus dang / de bzhin nyid kyi bsam gtan dang / de bzhin nyid kyi shes rab dang / de bzhin nyid kyi thabs dang / de bzhin nyid kyi smon lam dang /de bzhin nyid kyi stobs dang / de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes dang ldan pa dang / de bzhin nyid kyi sems can med pa dang / sems can yongs su thar bar byed pa dang ske/ sems can gyi gnas dang / 'khor ba na yang spyod la spyod pa thams cad las kyang yang dag par 'das pa dang / spyod pa las sgrol bar byed pa dang / de na 2yang yin la de nas yang ma yin pa dang / 'di na yang yin la 'di na yang ma yin pa dang / gnyis ka cilas dag pa dang / mun pa dang bral ba dang ske/ rtag tu gsal ba dang / mun pa med pa dang / mun pa'i ling togam5dang bral ba dang / de bzhin nyid kyi rjes su song ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa'i rjes su song ba de ltar 6na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya'o/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das zhes 7bya/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs pa bcom pa dang / chu bo las rgal nab dang / srid pa mthong ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi khur dang /srid pa 'joms 9pa dang / srid pa'i 'du shes dang bral ba dang / bdud bcom pa dang / khur bor ba dang / srid pa'i 'gro bar 'chi 'pho ba dang /59—338

skye bamagyo)dang / bya ba shes pa dang / srid pa'i 'dod chags bsal ba dang /lus dang sems sgomarsāpa dang / tshul khrims dang / shes rab bsgoms ripa dang ske/ srid pa'i skyon legs par mthong ba dang / srid pa'i sred pa dang bral ba dang / sems can la bsam pa ma btang ba dang / srid pa'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ba dang / chu lon dang zam pa legs par byas pa dang / mi gnas pas legs par mthong ba dang )/ rtag tu sgom 3)pa la yid kyis brtson pa dang /sems can gyi srid pa zad par 6byed pa dang / srid pa thams cad las rnam par log 47pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad thal bar rlogane par byed pa dang / srid pas rnam par rtse'9)ba la mkhas pa dang /srid pa gsum na yod pa rnams kyis mchod pa de ltar71 rin lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das zhes /1bya'o/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ‘/2ltar na byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin/'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' mtshams 3ldemed pa gang dang mnyam pa byang chub kyang de dang mnyam pas mnyam pa nyid du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par byed pa dang / lta ba'i rnam pa rnams dang /phyin ci 7log rnams dang / sgrib pa rnams dang / chod 15pa rnams dang /kun nas ldang ba rnams gang dang mnyam pa byang chub kyang de dang mnyam pas mnyam pa nyid du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par byed pa dang / 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang mnyam pa dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad gang 1zhedang mnyam pa byang chub kyang de dang mnyam pas mnyam pa nyid du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par byed 1 pa dang / so so'i skye bo'i chos 59—339

rnams dang / slob (1pa'i chos rnamasamananodang / nyan thos kyi chos rnams dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa'i chos rnams gang dang mnyam pa byang chub kyang de dang mnyam pas mnyam pa nyid du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par byed pa dang / mnyam pa nyid rnam par 'khrugs nopar mi byed pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum mnyam pa nyid kyis mnyam pa nyid du lta bar byed pa dang / chos thams cad gzod ma nas dag pa'i phyir rkyenas kyil rag 5las pa dang / yod pa ma yin pa'i yongs su rtog pas kun nas bslang ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa nyid du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par byed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin no//lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' ston pa yin/'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' gang la ston pa dang / rab tu ston pa dang / rjes su ston par byed pa de dag thams cad mi g.yos pa'i 6chos can du 'gyur ba dang / bstan pa yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su ston pa dang / rab tu ston pa dang / ston pa gcig pur 'gyur ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi skyabs dang / gling dang / dpung gnyen du 'gyur ba dang /mtshan ma thams cad zhi ba dang rab tu zhi ba dang / nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ba dang ske/ the tsom 7dang bral ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi the tsom rigacod pa la mkhas pa dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong gis phyag byas pa dang / yang dag par smra ba dang / khams gsum pas phyag byas pa dang / sems nam mkha' dang mnyam zhing khengs pa med pa dang /59—340
