yang dag pa'i mtha' legs par mthong ba'i phyir smad pa dang / brdeg pa dang /dgod pa dang / bshung ba dang / khro ba dang / skyo (1ba dang / bsdigs rinapa thams cad dang / rlom sems thams cad kyis zhum par mi 'gyur ba dang /sems can gyi rang bzhin legs par mthong ba'i phyir sems can thams cad la phan zhing snying brtse ba dang / 'jig rten la ston par grags par 'gyur ba de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' ston pa yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' so so caskye bo'i chos can yin/'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' thabs kyi so so 5skye bo'i spyod pa thams cad kyang ston par byed la shes pas so so 6skye bo'i spyod 7pa thams cad la chags par 8yang mi 'gyur ba de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' so so 9 skye bo'i chos can yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'dod chags kyi chos can yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la rjes su chags par 'gyur ba dang / rtag tu sangs rgyas kyi sku la kun tu chags par 'gyur ba dang / bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin dang ske/ snyoms par 'jug pa bsgrub pa'i phyir rtag tu dgon par gnas pa la rjes su chags par 'gyur ba dang / sems can rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis bsdu ba la rtag tu rjes su chags par 'gyur ba dang / sems can thams cad la zhe 'gras pa'i sems 1 rimed par 'gyur ba de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' 'dod chags kyi chos can yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' zhe sdang gi chos can yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras 59—341

pal/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' 'dus byas rnams la gcig tu nyes pa'i skyon chags par lta bar byed pa dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la sdang bar byed pa dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad dang / 'du byed thams cad la skyon du yang 'du shes la nyon mongs pa rnams dang 'du byed rnams spong 1bar yang mi byed pa dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rgyun gcod par mi byed pa dang / snying rje chen pos yang dag par zin pa'i yid kyis snying brtse ba rgya chen po yang dag par skyed 97par byed pa dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir sems can rnamasamasanyon mongs pa'i 'dam rdzob las 'byin par byed pa dang / sems can zhe sdang can rnams la bzod pa nye bar sgrub par byed cing nyon mongs pa rnams la nyes pa sbyin par byed pa dang / 'chi 'pho'i thabs thams cad dang / 'khor ba sun 'byin par byed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' zhe sdang gi chos can yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' gti mug gi chos can yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gti mug ces bya ba ni gang cung zad kyang mi shes pa yin pas de la gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi ngo bo nyid la snyoms par 'jug pa de/ shes par (4)mi byed / rnam par shes par mi byed/ kun tu shes par mi byed/ len par mi byed / spong bar mi byed/ 'byung bar mi byed/ 'jig par mi byed/ g.yo bar mi byed/ rlom sems su mi byed/ skyod 5/par mi byed cing / chos kyi zhirang bzhin gyis 'gog pa la snyoms par 'jug 7pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' gti mug gi chos can yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal 59—342

ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba'i chos can yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba las kyang mi g.yo la de nyid las kyang kyi /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams tshol bar yang byed pa dang /bdud thams cad dang thun mong ma ( yin zhing spyod pa dman pa rnams dang /ma 'dres pa dang / sems can rnams spyod pa dman pa las phral zhing spyod pa rgya chen po la 'god par byed pa dang / don 'thun par byed pa dang / mi dge ba thams cad la mi bsngags pa rjod ( par byed cing 'dun la pa bzlog pa dang /phyir zlogaskorapar byed pa dang / byang chub 'khor ba la gzhol bar shes par byed pa dang / 'khor ba mnyam pa nyid kyis 6)sangs rgyas mnyam pa nyid du lta bar byed pa dang / 'khor ba las mi g.yo zhing gnas par yang mi byed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba'i chos can yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i' chos can yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad rang bzhin gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das par ltam9)bar byed pa dang / chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis nye bar zhi bar shes par byed pa dang / sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las bzla 1 ba dang nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir chos ston par byed pa dang / sems can dpag tu med pa me gsum gyis 'bar bar gyur pa rnams nye bar zhi bar byed cing yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar byed pa dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa la yang spyod par byed la/ gtan du yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar yang mi byed pa de lta na lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' yongs su 53—343

mya ngan las 'da' ba'i chos can yin te/ thabs la mkhas pa dang / thabs shes pa la nges par skyes pa dang / sems can thams cad la phan pa dang /rjes su snying brtse ba dang ldan pa yin no/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas bstan pa 'di bshad pa na srog chags 'bum lhag tsam chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag go/ /srog chags drug khri ni len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo/ /sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed cing sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur 3)byas pa'i sems can rnams kyis ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur 2to/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyi khri lnga stong gis ni mi zad pa'i rnam pa'i dmadzod ces bya ba'i gzungs so sor thob par gyur to/ /srog chags sa ya phrag gnyis dang lnga 'bum gyis ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /steng gi bar snang las kyang bcom ldan 'das dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la mchod pa cadabya ba'i phyir me tog gi char dag mngon par rab tu phab bo/ /de nas lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' thabs dang shes rab kyisamaranges par 'byung ba yin/ de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas lha'i bu rab rtsal dzinosems la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gang tshe sems ni chags med pa/ /bla med byang chub sems yin te/ /sems kyi rang bzhin mngon sum pa/ /de ni shes rab mtshan nyid do/ /sems rnams bskyed pa thams cad ni/ /byang chub tu ni yongs bsngo zhing / /byang chub sems las rab rtas pa/ /de ni thabs kyi mtshan nyid do/ /sems can thams cad bdag med cing / /mi bden ya ma 59—344

brla ༅)gsog tu/ /gang tshe shes pas shes byed pa / /de ni shes rab mtshan nyid dom/ /gang phyir sems can thams cad dag /byang chub phyir ni sbyin byed cing / /bsam pa thag pas sdud byed pa/ /de ni thabs kyi mtshan nyid do/ /gang tshe bdag dang byang chub dag /gtan du mthong bar mi byed cing / /'khor gsum yongs su dag gyur pa/ /de ni shes rab mtshan nyid do/ /nang dang yang na phyi rol dag /thams cad yongs su gtong byed cing / /sems can kun la yongs bsngo ba/ /de ni thabs kyi mtshan nyid do/ /zhi zhing rab zhi ri rigatsang dag cing / /tshul khrims rlom sems mi byed la/ /lus dang ngag yid zhi gyur pa/ /de ni shes rab mtshan nyid do/ /tshul khrims la ni zhugs gyur cing / /gzhan yang tshul khrims sbyor byed la/ /sangs rgyas tshul khrims sngo byed pa/ /de phyir thabs zhes pabya ba yin/ /chos rnams thams cad rab stong zhing / /bdag med bzod pa sgoms byed la/ /lus dang sems kyis ma mas 7pa/ /de ni shes rab pha rol phyin / /lus kyis sbyor bar mi byed cing / /ngag dang sems kyis ma yin la/ /chos rnams kun la dben gyur pa/ /de ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ /sems can kun gyi khro ba dang / /gsod dang 'ching 8ba bzod byed cing / /sems can de dag mi spong ba/ /de ni thabs kyi pha rol phyin/ /sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyiral/ /bsam gtan bde ba rab spangs nas/ /grong dang yul 'khor snang byed pa / /de ni thabs kyi pha rol phyin/ /tshu rol ma yin pha rol min/ /'thun pa'i pha rol rab gnas shing / /spros pa'i lta ba rgyun bcad pa/ /shes rab pha rol phyin rtogs yin/ /gang gis stong nyid rtogs gyur nas/ /de ni btang snyoms mi byed cing / /sems can stong nyid sbyor byed pa/ /de ni thabs kyi tshul yin 59—345

no / /sangs rgyas gzugs med mkha' 'dra bar/ /chos kyi0)sgo nas ltadza byed cing ske/ /de tshe gzugs la zhen med pa/ /de ni shes rab mtshan nyid do/ /sangs rgyas mtshan nyid mchod 5'dod cing / /sangs rgyas bye ba mchod byed la/ /'dren kun mchod du 'jug byed pa/ /de phyir thabs zhes bya bams)yin/ /chos rnams rdul med rdul bral zhing / /mkha' dang mnyam pas mnyam gyur la/ /chos 'ga'ang 5'dzin par mi byed pa/ /de ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ /chos ni yongs su gzung ba'i phyir/ /lus dang srog ni 'dor byed cing / /'jig rten kun gyis dben gyur pa/ /de ni thabs kyi sgo yin no/ /chos dbyings gnas pa nyid kyi phyir/ /yang dag mtha' la rab gnas shing / /de bzhin nyid las mi g.yo ba/ /de ni shes rab sgo yin no/ /gang gi chos nyid ci 'dra ba/ /sems can de 'drar shes byed cing / /de ltar rtog par byed pa'i mtha' / /de ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ /chos kun 'chi 'pho yod min zhing / /skye ba med par shes byed la/ /mi 'gro rgyug par mi byed pa/ /de ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ /sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir/ /mkhas pas7)'dod dang gzugs rnams su/ /bsam mebazhin du ni skye byed pa/ /de dag thabs kyi yon tan yin/ /dgon pa gnas rab gnas byed cing / /nyon mongs med la rab gnas la/ /bsam gtan rnam thar rten byed pa/ /de dag shes rab mtshan nyid yin/ /grong dang yul 'khor rnams su ni/ /song nas snyan gtam ston byed cing / /mi zad zhum pa yod min pa'i/ /mkhas pa thabs la mkhas pa yin / /'jig rten gsum po thams cad las/ /skrag cing 'du 'dzi bsten 8 med la/ /bdag nyid dul zhing zhi gyur pa/ /de ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ /59—346

'gro ba dag na 'dus7)chen dang / /tshogs dang 'du 'dzi ji snyed pa/ /kun na snang50ba de dag ni/ /thabs kyis smras pa med pa yin/ /brtan pa chags med spyod55)byed cing / /yi ge don gnyer mi byed la/ /brjod med nges don don gnyer ba/ /de ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ /mkhas pa chags pa thams cad na/ /snang zhing chos rnams ston byed la/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bsngags54)brjod pa//de ni thabs kyi pha rol phyin/ /mngon shes shes la mkhas gyur cing / /zhi zhing dul la zag pa med/ /gdeg 57med gzhag pa yod min pa/ /de ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ /mngon shes dag la rnam 'phrul zhing / /zhing rnams bye bar 'gro byed la/ /sangs rgyas bye ba mang mchod pa/ /de ni thabs kyi mtshan nyid yin/ /phung po sgyu ma 'drar shes shing / /nyon mongs dngos med shes byed (6)nas/ /de dag bdud kun zhi gyur pa/ /de ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ /bdud rnams thams cad ston byed cing / /bstan nas rgyal bar byed gyur la/ /de las sems can thar byed pa/ /de ni thabs kyi sgo yin no/ /stong nyid mtshan ma med pa dang / /smon par byed pa yod min pa'i/ /rnam thar sgo la stonas7)byed pa/ /de ni shes rab mtshan nyid yin/ /chags med sdang ba yod min zhing / /rmongs med shes pa'i spyod yul dang / /blang med dor ba yod min pa/ /de ni shes rab mtshan nyid yin/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan zhing / /stong nyid rab tu sten 8)gyur la/ /kun gyi pha rol son gyur pa/ /mnyam nyid 9'gog pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /zag med brtul ba ma yin pa/ /de dag shes rab ldan 'gyur zhing ske/ /'khor ba'i spyod yul de dag ni/ /sems can kun gyi 7grogs su 'gyur / /bsod nams tshogs kyis mi ngoms pa'i/ /mkhas pa thabs la mkhas 53—347

pa yin/ /shes rab thabs la mkhas pa yi/ /yan lag gnyis ldan lam de ni/ /shes ldan byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /des ni 'dren rnams nges par 'byung7)/ /thabs dang mi ldan shes rab kyis/ /ma byung 'byung bar 'gyuralab med/ /shes rab med pa'i thabs kyis ni/ /mkhas pa rab tu zhi mi 'gyur/ /shes rab dang ni thabs shes pa/ /de gnyis kun tu 'dres gyur cing / / gnyis gte5)zung du 'jug 'gyur na/ /des ni dam pa rtogs par 'gyur/ /gang dag bgrod pa 'dir 'gro ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab bsngags shing / /ye shes pha rol phyin 'gyur te/ /de ni chos rnams chos nyid do/ /de dag sangs rgyas spyod yul gyi / /chos dbyings dbyer med dga' byed cing / /sangs rgyas byang chub bla med pa'i/ /rdul med byang chub rtogs par 'gyur/ /lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis ca'ajam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la gzhan yang 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal byang chub kyi yul gang yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu byang chub kyi yul ni rang gi yul dben pa nyid do3na/ /lha'i bus smras pa/'jam dpal byang chub kyi mtshan nyid gang yin/ 'jam dpalamadu gyis smras pa/lha'i bu byang chub ni nam mkha'i mtshan nyid do/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub kyi mtha' gang yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu byang chub kyi mtha' ni stong pa nyid yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub kyi gnas gang yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu byang chub kyi gnas ni chos thams cad kyi gnas yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub kyi sgo gang yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu byang chub kyi sgo ni kun nas sgo yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub kyi rtsom pa 59—348

gang yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu byang chub kyi rtsom pa ni sems can thams cad bdag med pa'o/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub ci dang mnyam/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu byang chub ni chos thams cad mi skye ba dang mnyam mo/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub kyi bgrod pa gang yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu byang chub kyi bgrod pa ni sems can thams cad kyi sems dang spyod pa yin no/ /byang chub kyi bgrod pa ni 'gro bas1med par 'gro ba dang / rgyu ba med par 'gro ba yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub gang gi rgyu 'thun pa yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu byang chub ni snying rje chen po'i rgyu 'thun pa yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal snying rje chen po gang gi rgyu 'thun pa yin/'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu snying rje chen po ni sems can thams cad rab tu thar bar bya ba'i rgyu 'thun pa yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub ga las btsal nabar bya/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu byang chub ni sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa rjes su rtogs pa las btsal bar bya'o/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal nyon mongs pa rnams ga las btsal bar bya/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu nyon mongs pa rnams ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa las btsal bar bya'o/ /lha'i bus smras pa/'jam dpal ci 'phags pa'i lam nyon mongs pa rnams dang lhan cig gnas sam/'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gal te 'phags pa'i lam gnyis su gyur pa zhig yin na ni/ 'phags pa'i lam nyon mongs pa rnams dang lhan cig gnas par yang 'gyur ba zhig na / lha'i bu 'phags pa'i lam ni gnyis su gyur pa 53—349

med pa ste/ nyon mongs pa tshol ba gang yin pa de nyid 'phags pa'i lam yin no//lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na lam gyis lam gyi bya ba byas pa yin/'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe btsal na nyon mongs pa nyu)rnams mi rnyed cing 'khor ba yang mi rnyed/ mya ngan las 'das pa yang mi rnyed pa de ltar〈2din lam gyis lam gyi bya ba byas pa yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa'i lam gang yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa'i lam ni lta ba'i rnam pa drug cu rtsa gnyis dang / phyin ci log bzhi dang / sgrib pa lnga dang / mi dge ba'i phyogs kyi chos thams cad do/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ci las bsams 5)te de skad smra/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' ni sems can la sbyor ba yin pas sems can rnams kyang lta ba'i rnam pa dang / phyin ci log dang /sgrib pa dang / mi dge ba'i chos rnams ma gtogs pa gzhan las btsal bar mi bya'o/ / de ci'i phyir zhe na tsho/ byang chub sems dpa' ni gang gis sems can rnams rab tu phye ba'i lta ba'i rnam pa dang / phyin ci log dang / sgrib pa dang —/ nyon mongs pa de dag nyid tshol bar byed de/ de tshol bar byed na sems can yang mi rnyed/ nyon mongs pa rnams kyang mi rnyed do/ /ma rnyed na sems can yongs su smin par bya ba la skyo bar mi 'gyur ba ste/ lha'i bu rnam grangs des na nyon mongs pa tshol ba ni byang chub sems dpa'i lam yin la/sems can tshol ba yang byang chub sems dpa'i lam yin/ phung po dang /khams dang / skye mched dang / nyon mongs pa tshol ba yang byang chub sems dpa'i lam yin nor/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal rnam par thar pa'i sgo 53—350

gsum po dag byang chub sems dpa'i lam ma7yin nam/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu stong pa nyid ni btsal bar mi nus la/ mtshan ma med pa dang /smon pa med pa yang btsal bar mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lha'i bu de la ni sems dang / yid dang / rnam par shes pa 'jug par mi 'gyur la gang la sems dang / yid dang / rnam par shes pa 'jug par mi 'gyur ba de ni btsal bar mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal lamakhuji ltar mngon par rtogs par bya/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu yang dag pa'i lta ba gang dang mnyam pa log pa'i lta ba yang de dang mnyam pa de ltar mngon par rtogs pa gang yin pa de ni lam mngon par rtogs pa yin no/ /yang dag pa'i rtog pa gang dang mnyam pa log pa'i rtog pa yang ③de dang mnyam pa dang /yang dag pa'i ngag gangasredang mnyam pa log pa'i ngag kyang de dang mnyam pa dang /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' gang dang mnyam pa log pa'i las kyi mtha' yang de dang mnyam pa dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba gang dang mnyam pa log pa'i 'tsho ba yang de dang mnyam pa dang / yang dag pa'i rtsol ba gang dang mnyam pa log pa'i rtsol ba yang de dang mnyam pa dang / yang dag pa'i dran pa gang dang mnyam pa log pa'i dran pa yang de dang mnyam pa dang / yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang〈gedang mnyam pa log pa'i ting nge 'dzin kyang de dang mnyam pa de ltar mngon par rtogs pa gang yin pa de ni lam mngon par rtogs pa yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/'jam dpal yang dag pa'i lta ba gang dang mnyam/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/lha'i bu yang dag pa'i lta ba dang log pa'i lta ba ni stong pa nyid dang / dben pa nyid dang mnyam pa yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal stong pa nyid 53—351

dang dben pa nyid la tha dad du bya ba ci yod/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/lha'i bu nam mkha' dang nam mkha' la tha dad du bya ba ci yod/ lha'i bus smras pa/'jam dpal tha dad du bya ba chungakhezad kyang med do/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa / lha'i bu de bzhin du stong pa nyid dang / dben pa nyid la yang tha dad dusabya ba chung༄zad kyang med do/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal tha dad du bya ba gang las rab tu phye ba yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu tha dad du bya ba ni mtshan ma dang / dmigs pa dang / 'du shes dang / sprosalgepa las rab tu phye ba yin te/ mtshan ma dang / dmigs pa dang / 'du shes dang /spros pa gang yin pa de'i ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid rjes su rtogs〈nyapa gang yin pa de la ni tha dad du bya ba med do/ /lha'i bu 'di lta ste dper na/ rgya mtsho chen por ma zhugs pa'i chu la ni tha dad du bya ba yod kyi rgya mtsho chen por zhugs pa'i chu la ni tha dad du bya ba med pa de bzhin du/ lha'i bu chos kyi dbyings yongs su ma shes pa la ni chos thams cad 97tha dad du bya ba yod kyi chos kyi dbyings yongs su shes pa la ni 3)chos tha dad du bya ba med do/ /lha'i bus smras pa/'jam dpal ci chos kyi dbyings yongs su shes par nus sam/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu chos kyi dbyings ni yongs su shes par mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lha'i bu chos thams cad ni chos kyi dbyings su yang dag par 'du ba yin la/ chos kyi dbyings kyis ni chos kyi dbyings yongs su mi shes pa'i phyir ro/ /chos kyi dbyings su yang dag par 'du ba'i chos de dag la gnyis su med par shes pa de dag gang yin pa de ni yongs su shes pa zhes bya ste/ sems gcig nas gcig tu brgyud 77pa nye bar zhi bar byed pa'i phyir de ni yongs su shes 59—352

pa zhes bya'o/ /gzhan gyi rnam par rig pa la gnas pa'i phyir de ni yongs su shes pa zhes bya'o/ /lha'i bu 'di lta ste dper na nam mkha'atsha1)gzugs med pa'i snang ba la gzugs thams cad snang yang gzugs de dag ni nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid yin pa de bzhin du/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpas rang gisaman)smras pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi sgo nas chos thams cad mthong yang chos de dag ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid kho na yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mgo smos pas go ba yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu mgo smos pas go ba'i rang gi lta bas sems can thams cad kyi lta ba spang ba'i phyir chos ston pas dbyed na'o/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnam par spros pas go ba yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/lha'i bu dben pa'i phyir bdag kyang gzhan du mi byed la/ bdag med pa yang gzhan du mi byed na'o/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi bkri ba yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' chos 'ga' yang khrid par 'dami byed na'o/ /lha'i bus smras pa / 'jam dpal ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' gnas lhur len pa yin/'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' mtshan ma med pa'i gnas las g.yo bar mi byed na'o/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal gang gis byang chub sems dpa' tshogs gsum po nges pa nyid dang / ma nges pa nyid dang / log pa nyid du nges pa'i tshogs dag la snang bar 'gyur ba'i rnam grangs yod dam/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu yod do/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ji lta bu yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu 53—353

byang chub sems dpa' nges pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la'o/ /ma nges pa ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la'o/ /log pa nyid du nges pa ni de las sems can bsgral bamanyu)bya ba la'o/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal gang gis byang chub sems dpa' mi khom pa'5)thob cing khom pa ma thob pa'i rnam grangs yod dam/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu 5yod do/ /lha'i bus smras pa/'jam dpal 'o na ci'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' mi khom pa thob pa rnams la snying rje chen po skyed par byed cing sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir khom pa thob pa de dag kyang yal bar 'jog par byed/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa / lha'i bu gang rnam par grol ba'i tshogs de dag ni khom pa thob pa yin pas de la ni byang chub sems dpar mi snang ngo / /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal khyod mi khom pa thob pa yin nam/ 'on te khom pa thob pa yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu kho bo ni khom pa thob pa yang 5ma yin/ mi khom pa thob pa yang ma yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal ci'i phyir/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu 6kho bo ni thob 7)yang ma yin/ yang dag par thob pa yang ma yin/ khom pa yang ma yin/ mi khom pa yang ma yin la/ khom pa dang mi khom pa la chags par yang mi byed pa'i phyir ro/ /lha'i bus smras pa/'jam dpal chos kyi rnam grangs 'dis ni bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad tshar gcod 9do/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu 'di ltar chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la ni phung po yongs su shes pa yang med/ nyon mongs pa sel ba yang med/bdud las yang dag par 'das pa yang med pa'i phyir ro/ /lha'i bus smras pa/'jam dpal nye bar sbyar 1 bas gzhan mu stegs can rnams 31pham par byas so/ /59—354

'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu 'di ltar 'di la mu stegs can 17thams cad kyi spyodasngo pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal chos kyi tog btsugs so/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu snang ba med pa dang mun pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal 'dis ni chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor tos// /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu lta ba'i mtha' thams cad yongs su gcadamaching pa'i phyir ro/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal chos bstan pa 'dis smi chos kyi snang ba ji snyed cig byas/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa / lha'i bu gang dag la snang ba yang med la 6mun pa yang med pa de dag chos kyi 7)snang bar byas so/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal sems can gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas mos par 'gyur ba de dag ni dkon no/ / 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/48 9lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal 'di la su dag mos par 'gyur1 / 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang dag 'ching bas rnam par 'khrug par mi 'gyur ba rnams so/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal 'ching bas rnam par 'khrug par mi 'gyur ba dag gang yin/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu gang dag 'dod 11chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang glu/ nyon mongs pa bsal ba'i sgo nas thar ba tshol bar mi byed pa dang /gang dag 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / nyon mongs pa mnyam pa nyid kyi 12rnam par grol ba mnyam par 'gyur ba 1 dag ste/ de dag gis ni 'ching ba ma dmigs pas rnam par 'khrug pa yang 1 mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro / /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas bstan pa 'di bshad pa na srog chags lnga 'bum tsam gyis byang chub tu sems bskyed nas tshig 'di skad ces bdag cag 59wa 355

gis kyang ci 41ltar 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis chos 'di dag brnyes pa de bzhin du thob par gyur cig ces kyang smras so/ /lha dang mi rnams kyi skye dgu las srog chags 'bum lhag tsam ni lachos rnams la chos kyi mig55)rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag go/ /gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu drug khri ni len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo/ /'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i bu brgyad khri yang len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo/ /srog chags dang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma nyi khri yang len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa bdun khri nyis stong gis ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor rnams kyang dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / yidangarangs pa dang / rab tu dga' ba dang / dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas ched du brjod 5pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o kun nas yongs grol ba'i / /dmigs med chos ni legs par bshad/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa yis/ /shin du legs par bshad par byas/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang /lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci tsho6dang / lto 'phye chen po dang ske/ mi dang / mi ma yin pa de dag gis lha dang mi'i mchod pa dag byas te/steng gi bar snang las kyang lha'i 7me tog gi char dag kyangs phab/ rin po che'i char dag kyang phab/ gos kyi char dag kyang phab/ bdug spos kyi char dag 59—356

dang ske/ spos chu'i char dag dang / phye ma'i char dag kyang phab bo/ /lha rnams kyis steng gi bar snang las lha'i sil snyan brgya stong dag kyang rab tu gsil bar gyuramatsho)to/ /dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma rnams dang / rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis kyang rang rang gi 'byor pa ci bdog pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das dang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la mchod pa byas so/ /thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor rnams kyis kyang thal mo sbyar te tshig 'di skad ces/ bcom ldan 'das gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la dad par mi bgyid pa de dag la ni sangs rgyas 'byung ba ma mchis lags so/ /gang dag chos kyi rnam nagrangs 'di spong bar bgyid pa de dag la ni rab tu 'byung ba ma mchis lags so/ /gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bsgrubs te riganas par mi bgyid pa de dag la ni bsnyen par rdzogs par 4ma mchis lags so/ /de dag la ni 'phags pa'i bsnyen pas5)rdzogs pas bsnyen par rdzogs pa yang ma mchis lags so/ /gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bgrod par mi mchi ba de dag la ni dge sbyong gi tshul ma mchis lags so/ /de dag la ni bram ze'i tshul yang ma mchis lags so/ /gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la skrag par 'gyur ba de dag la ni thob pa yang ma mchis/mngon par rtogasam nopa yang ma mchis lags so/ /gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan par bgyid pa dang / thos nas kyang mos par bgyid pa dang / len par bgyid pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa dang / 'dzin par bgyid pa dang ske/ klog par bgyid pa dang / yi ger 'dri bar bgyid pa dang / snod 'tshal bar bgyid nas gzhan dag la yang ston par bgyid pa dang / skyo ba ma mchis pa'i yid kyis 'doms par bgyid pa dang / rjes su ston par bgyid pa 53—357

dang ske/ 'di la nan tan gyis sgrub par bgyid pa dang / gzhan dag kyang nan tan gyis sgrub tu stsol ba dang / nyams par mi bgyid pa de dag ni sems can dam pa dang / sems can chen po dang / dge0)ba'i rtsa ba bsrungs pa dang /sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur bgyis pa dang / gting (mirnyed pa dang /log par ltung ba'i rgyun bkum pa dang / ngan song dang ngan 'gro'i sgo bkum pa dang ske/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la shin tu gus spyo pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la bgyis pa gzos zhing bgyis pa tshor ba lags shing / de dag ni 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis〈snye/dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung ba'i slad du zhugs pa lags te/ skyes bu dam pa de dag la ni sangs rgyas 'byung ba yang mchis lags so/ /de dag la ni chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yang mchis lags so/ /de dag la ni 'bras bu mchis pa dang ske/ khom pa dang ldan pa lags so zhes kyang gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag la legs so zhes bya ba byin nas byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la bka' stsal pa/ byams pa chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na/ lha dang mi rnams kyi skye dgu las srog chags nyi khri nyis snyestong ni chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag go / /lha dang mi rnams kyi skye dgu las srog 'chags 'bum phrag brgyad ni len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo/ /lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi 'am ci 7dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang /53—358

dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma sa ya phrag gnyis kyis ni byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /'di na gnas pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dag nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' lnga 'bum gyis ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzodamatu)pa thob par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' bsam pa tha dad pa nyis stong tsam gyis ni gzungs〈misna tshogs so sor thob par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bum gyis ni gzungs dri ma med pa so sor thob par gyur to/ /de dag las byang chub sems dpa' mang po dag byang chub sems dpa' byams pa khyod kyis byang chub thob pa'i dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur zhing mdo sde zab mo 'di lta bu dag nod pa dang / ston pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / klog par yang 'gyur te/ de dag ni byams pa khyod nyid kyis byang chub tu lung ston par 'gyur rol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas ( ge)'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang dag mdo sde 'di 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / ston pa dang / yi ger 'dri ba dang ske/ dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du glegs bam du bgyis te 'chang ba dang / tha na lan 'ga' zhig nyan par bgyid pa dang / rna lam du grags par bgyid pa de dag bsod nams 4)ji tsam skyed par 'gyur lags / de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /byams pa khyod de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'di yongs su 'dri bar sems pa ni legs so legs so/ /byams pa de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig5nanadang ngas khyod la bshad par bya'o/ /byams pa nan gyis dper na lha dang mi rnams kyi skye dgu las 53—359

lha'am mi gang zhig gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'khor gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dang bcas pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed cig la bskal pa gang gā'i nyu)klung gi bye ma snyed du bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byas par gyur pa de bas ni gang gis mdo sde legs par gsungs pa 'di yi ger bris te 'dzin pa dang ske/ klog pa dang / de bzhin nyid du sgrub par byed pa dang / gzhan dag la ston par byed pa de 2ches bsod nams mang du bskyed par 'gyur te/ byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i phyir ring porarsāmi thogs par byang chub kyi snying por nye bar 'gro bar yang 'gyur ro/ /byams pa nga ni gang dag gis /lamado sde 'di thos nas spong sgrubar mi byed cing mos par byed pa dang / tha na glegs bam du 'dri 6bar byed pa de dag kyang mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du phyir mi ldog pa nyid du lung ston to/ /byams pa nga ni gang dag gis mdo sde zab mo 'di lta bu 'di ni ming tsam thos pa de dag kyang / 'bras bu yod par lung ston par byed na gang dag mos pa dang / yi ger 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang /gzhan dag la yang ston par byed pa dag lta smos kyang ci dgos/ gang dag mdo sde 'di yi ger 'dri 7ba dang / lung nod pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang /klog pa dang / de bzhin nyid du sgrub par byed pa de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom snyeldan 'das rnams dang lhan cig tu gtam 'dre nabar byed pa dang / phebs par smra bar byed par 'gyur te/ de dag ni rtag tu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur zhing 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dag na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis kyang de dag la ston par mdzad cing bla na med pa yang 59wa 360

dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par yang 1)'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos pas3de ni sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang 'dra ba yin gyis57kun dga' bo khyod kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di zung shigazhi) /gzhan dag la yang rgya cher ston cig /kun dga' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci zhes bgyi/ 'di ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/'di'i ming ji skad bstan par bgyi lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / kun dga' bo chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba dang / 'jam dpal gyis bstan pa chos thams cad rnam par gtan la dbab pa bstan pa zhes bya bar yang zung shigazi /de nas 'khor de dag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming thos nas thal mo sbyar te 6)bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas chos bstan pa mang du thos lags na ji ltar chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 7rab tu rnam par phye ste rgya cher bstan pa de lta bu'i chos ni nam yang ma byung lags so/ /bdag cag gis kyang chos kyi rnam 8grangs la dga' ba ci 'di lta bu thob pa 9sngon ma myong lags te/ de lta lags pas bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas kyang skye bo mang po la sman pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i skye bo rnams kyi slad du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ci nas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bgyid par 'gyur ba dang / sems can mos pa tha dad pa rnams kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du theg pa tha dad pas nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / de dag bde 'gror mchi bar bgyi bar bcom ldan 59—361

dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la dus gsum du rjes su yi tu rang bas mi gtang bar bya'o / /tshong dpon gyi bu gzhan yang las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpas5kyini snying thag pa rus pa'i khong nas yid las 4byas te/ sems can thams cad kyis bsams zinas dus gsum du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon pa dang /bdag nyid sdig pa'i ne spyod pa la rnam par smod pa dang / sdig pa spyod pa la57kyibashung ba dang / sdig pa las nges parang 'byung ba dang / dge ba thams cad 'dod pa dang / dge ba thams cad blang ba dang / tshe rabs tshe rabs su yangs9nodakon mchog gsum la bsnyen bkur 1 tshobya bar gsol ba gdab pa dang / gcig tu nges par rnam par dag pa'i dge ba'i spyad pa spyod par gsol ba gdab pa dang ske/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par bya bar gsol ba 11gdab pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad 'thob par gsol ba 12gdab pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol btso gdab pa dang ske/ bskal pa du mar chos bstan par gsol ba mugadab pa 7mi gtang bar bya'o / /tshong dpon gyi bu gzhan yang las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpas ni pha ma la 17gnod pa med pa dang / bu dang / chung ma dang / bran pho dang /bran mo dang / las byed pa dang / zho shas 1 'tsho ba dang / mdza' bo dang / snyeblon po dang / nye du dang / rgan rabs la gnod pa med par kyi ji ltar mos pa dang ske/ ci nus par dus dus su sbyin pa sbyin par bya'o/ /tshong dpon gyi bu gzhan yang las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpas ni bslab pa'i gzhi lnga la gnas zhing 19'dug pa dang / brtan por 'dug pa dang / mi lhod par 'dug par bslab par bya'o/ /gal te bslab pa'i gzhi lnga la slob 3 mi nus na yang /59—378

des bzhi'am/ gsum mamanyu)/ gnyis sam/ de'i nang nas bslab pa'i gzhi gcigadza tsam la yang bslab par bya'o/ /gal te bslab pa'i gzhi gcigs ritsam la slob kyang mi nus na de sdig pa'i las mi dge ba gang dang gang kun tu spyod pa de la zhen pa ma yin pa dang / drag po ma yin pa'i sems dang / mi dga' ba zhenam pa dang / lhod pa dang / yang ba'i sems dang / don gyi dbang dang /dgos pa'i dbang gis spyad par bya ste/ des 5)mi dge ba bcu'i las khro ba'i 6kyidabang du gyur pa dang / 'khon 7du 'dzin pa'i dbang du gyur pa dang / dga' ba dang mchog tu dga' ba'i dbang du gyur pas kun tu spyad par mi bya'o/ /kun tu spyad par 'dod pa (8na yang rnam par smad par bya/ rnam par bshung bar bya'ol/ /spyod cing 'dug pa na yang rnam par smad par bya/ rnam par bshung bar bya'o/ /spyad zin 9pa na yang rnam par smad par bya/ rnam par bshung bar byuX ri / so sor bshags par bya1 / nges par 'byung bar bya'o/ /legs pa dge ba ci yang rung ba zhig /kun tu spyod pa na yang 12des ni de la sems zhen pa dang la/ drag po'i 12sems dang / tshim pa dang / mgu ba dang / stod pa ma yin pa dang / yang ba 1 ma yin pa dang / bar chad med pa dang / dad pa 15dang ske/ dga' ba dang / dang ba gludang / mchog tu dga' ba'i dbang du gyur pa'i sems kyis kun tu spyad par bya'o/ /kun tu spyod par 'dod pa na yang snying thag pa rus pa'i khong nas yid la byas te/ sems can 1 thams cad kyis bsams 18nas sems can thams cad bsgral ba'i phyir dang / dgrol ba'i phyir dang ske/ dbugs dbyung ba'i phyir dang / yongs su mya ngan las bzla 9ba'i phyir dang ske/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par bya ba'i phyir dang / sangs rgyas kyi 59—379

chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar bya'o/ /des dge ba kun tu spyod pa 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba thams cad la yang snying thag pa rus pa'i khong nas yid la byas te/ sems can thams cad kyis bsams 1nas mngon par bsdus te bzlums nanas rjes su yi rang bar bya'o/ /rjes su yis rang ba'i mchog dang / phul dang / gtso bo dang / rab dang / rab mchog dang ske/ gya rnam pa dang / dam pa dang / mnyam pa med pa dang / mi mnyam pa dang / mnyam pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa dang / mnyam pa'i rjes su yi rang 4bas rjes su yi skurang bar bya'o/ /rjes su yi ci rangs nas kyang dge ba kun tu spyad pa de yang sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / nyan thos thams cad la dbul 7bar bya'o/ /phul nas kyang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du bya zhing ske/ sems can thams cad bsgral ba'i phyir dang / dgrol ba'i phyir dang /dbugs dbyung ba'i phyir dang / yongs su mya ngan las bzla 8ba'i phyir dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'thob 9par bya ba'i phyir nyin gcig bzhin du dus gsum du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar bya'o/ /des ka 1 shi ku'i gos dang / tsan dan dang / a ga 1ru'i bdug 12pa la sogs pa dang / yo byad rnam pa sna tshogs nyams su myong ngam/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la dga' mgur spyod dam/ lam du 'gro ba'am/ 'du byed dam/ bya ba thams cad byed pa 12na yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 59wa 380

'dun pa dang / dad pa dang / don du gnyer ba dang / smon pa de 'ba' zhig 1)rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad dpar rjes su dran par bya'o/ /yid la bya'o/ /bsgom par bya'o/ /lan mang du bya'o/ /de ltar byas na de 5sdig pa mi dge ba kun tu spyod pa rnams la sems lhod par 'gyur/ yang bar 'gyur / chung bar 'gyura'i/ srab par 'gyur/ gsog tu 'gyur ro/ /legs par dge ba'i las kun tu spyod pa rnams la ni sems zhen par 'gyur/ drag par 'gyur/mi lhod par 'gyur/ mi yang bar 'gyur/ mi chung bar 'gyur ro/ /de sdig pa mi dge ba kun tu spyod pa rnams la lhod par 'gyur/ yang bar 'gyur/ chung bar 'gyur/ srab par 'gyur/ gsog tu 'gyur / med par 'gyur ba 7dang ske/ legs pa nadage ba'i rtsa ba kun tu spyod pa rnams la sems zhen par gyur pas srid pa'i 'gro ba gang dang phrad pa dag tu chung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'khu ba dang ske/ gsod pa dang / 'ching ba dang / rnam par 'tshe ba gang yin pa rnams legs par spang ba 9dang / 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa'i khongs su gtogs pa'i sems can mtha' yas mu med pa rnams kyis 1 thog ma med pa'i dus nas bsags pa dus mtha' yas par nyams su myong bar 'gyur ba'i skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal dang / mi sdug pa dang phrad pa dang / sdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal ba 1 dang / 'dod pas 4phongs 12pa'i sdug bsngal dang / lha dang / mi 15dang / lha ma yin dang /dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dang / sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal dang /'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug gi sdug bsngal gcad 15par bya ba dang glu/ dgag 7par bya ba dang / rnam par zhi bar bya ba'i phyir zhugs pa dang /59wa 381

byams pa'i sems su gyur pa dang / snying rje chen po'i sems su gyur pa dang /go cha chen po bgos 1pa dang / theg pa chen po la zhugs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rgya chen po la mos pa dang / sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun gyi gdung mi 'chad par nges par byed pa'i phyir sdig pa mi dge ba kun tu spyod pa rnams yongs su 'grib par 'gyur ba dang / chung bar 'gyur ba nas srab pa'i bar du 'gyur ro/ /legs pa dge ba kun tu spyod pa rnams na)ni 'phel bar 'gyur ba nas dpag tu med pa'i bar du 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa sogs shing sgom pa yang yongs su rdzogs pa dang / sra ba dang / brtan pa dang / rdo rje lta bur 'gyur ro/ /tshong dpon gyi bu de lta 4na las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de go rims snye 'di lta bus mthar gyis srid pa 'di dang / srid pa phyi ma dang / srid pa lan grangs gzhan dag la sdig pa mi dge ba kun tu 0spyod pa 'grib par byed pa dang / chung 7ngur byed pa nas gsog tu byed pa'i bar dang / legs pa dge ba 8kun tu spyod pa 'phel bar 'gyur ba nas dpag tu med pa'i bar du 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa yang sogs shing sgom 9par byed de/ legs pa dge ba kun tu spyad pa rnams yongs su smin pas myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i snyebyang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas de'i tshe yul da ra da nas da 1 ra da'i rgyal po sin du gi ri zhes bya ba'i bu bcom ldan 'das la blta 11ba dang / phyag bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir bā rā ṇa sīr 12song nas de bcom ldan 'das dang thag mi ring ba zhig na 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas da 1 ra da'i rgyal po sin du gi ri'i bu stan 1 las langs te/ bla gos phrag 59wa 382

pa gcig tu gzar nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das khyod 1rikyis legs par bka' stsal to/ /bde bar gshegs pa khyod kyis legs par bka' stsal to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems kyis gegasol ba 5ci'adebs shing snying thag pa rus pa'i khong nas yid la bgyis te/ sems canas thams cad kyis bsams 3)nas dus gsum du gsol ba 6 'debs shing brjod pa gang lags pa de tsam yang bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi tshogs nya'aphel bar 'gyur zhing yang dag par rab tu 'phel bar 'gyur/ sogs 8)par 'gyur/ grangs ma mchis par bgyid / byang chub sems dpa'is 9bsam pa yang sogs shing 1 sgom pa dang /yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhing sra ba dang / brtan pa dang / rdo rje lta bur 'gyur na gong du rtsol zhing brtson pa mi gtong ba lta ci smos lags/ bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang snying thag pa rus pa'i khong nas yid la bgyid de/ sems can 11thams cad kyis bsams 12nas sems can thams cad bsgral ba dang / dgrol 1ribar bgyi ba dang / dbugs dbyung ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las bzla 5ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba dang /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par bgyi ba'i slad du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam 'debs te/ sems can ma rgal dab rnams sgrol ba tsi/ma grol ba rnams 'grol ba/ dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs 'byin pa/yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las zlo 18ba'i sangs rgyas su gyur cig /yang dang yang du lan brgyar bsnan 9te/ mtha' yas pa 59wa 383

mtha' yas par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam 'debs lags so/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu dpal dbyigatsha1)gis kyang de'i rjes thogs su de bzhin du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon nalam btab bo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/tshong dpon gyi bu dpal dbyig dang / da /nor da'i rgyal po'i bu dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / dge slong de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang /lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yis rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa dpal dbyig gis 5zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs sone// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po su rend+ra 7bo dhi dang / pradzñā brla nadang / zhu 9chen gyi lotstsha ba bande ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //59—384
